st.g:
-Stack all 3 Garm; interrupt The Ram's Voice (PBAoE) and The Dragon's Voice (donut).
-Avoid the three persistent fire zones; then group and burn the follow-up adds.
st.d:
-Help interrupt Voices; stay out of the fire lanes.
-Cleave down the trash packs quickly once grouped.
st.h:
-Expect spikes if a Voice goes off; spot-heal clipped players.
-Position to heal through incidental burn ticks while moving.
st.t:
-Grab and face all Garms; slide the pack away from fire zones.
-Use interruptions on Voices; keep adds gathered for AoE.

st.g:
-Double Vision: alternate red/white to reset stacks (3 stacks = death).
-Mortal Gaze: look away or cleanse Doom on the lit disk; kill Hourglasses for Roulette and avoid the lit quadrant at the final pop.
st.d:
-Control circle puzzles: Level 100 Flare needs an odd count; Level 150 Death fails on multiples of 3.
-Swap to adds/Hourglasses immediately to prevent raidwides.
st.h:
-Call out Doom fix (lit disk) and pre-shield for Roulette resolution.
-Be ready for burst if circles are mishandled; top quickly after mechanics.
st.t:
-Keep boss centered so players can swap colors cleanly.
-Pick up spawned adds; avoid facing the raid during Mortal Gaze casts.

st.g:
-Interrupt Ancient Flare/Ancient Quaga.
-Kill Forbidden Gates before Void Call; prioritize the larger gates later.
st.d:
-Swap hard to Gates and the clone; ignore fluff until casts are stopped.
-Tag larger gates first to prevent Jormungand spawns.
st.h:
-Mitigate/heal if an interrupt is missed; stabilize after gate waves.
-Help target-call priority gates while moving minimally.
st.t:
-Use interrupts on Scylla/Xande's Clone if available.
-Pick up spawns and hold them off the group while DPS delete Gates.

st.g:
-Avoid white swirls (Ice Floor) or get Deep Freeze; kill Slimes and stand in the poison puddle to halt spawns.
-Discordance: AoE the 5 heads or wipe; soak the small stack marker with 3–5 players; kill Prominence orbs before Radiance.
st.d:
-Priority: Orbs → Slimes/Toxic Slime → Discordance heads.
-Pass the Dragonfire Fly tether quickly before Suppuration stacks ramp.
st.h:
-Cleanse Concussion if applied; pre-heal stack markers and orb failures.
-During Heatwave, minimize actions; rely on oGCDs to steady the raid.
st.t:
-Park boss to keep puddles and orb lanes clear.
-Grab Toxic Slime/stray adds.

st.g:
-Alliance A/B/C take left/mid/right platforms; HP sync means all die together.
-If crosshair targets you, bait cone down; use jump pad to return; stand in the purple puddle for Shockwave or be knocked off.
st.d:
-Kill the Sacrificed Soldier quickly; avoid the spinning yellow disc.
-Help activate jump pads if teammates get pulled below.
st.h:
-Top players returning from the lower ring; rescue anyone drifting off pads.
-Pre-shield before Shockwave if groups are messy.
st.t:
-Keep Atomos centered; help trigger jump pads on top.
-Position to avoid dragging cones through your group.

st.g:
-Unchained: get Mini, enter belly via purple puddle, kill wall adds; outside team re-chain with both fetters.
-Common strat: DPS Rush (all DPS + 1 healer inside). Stay grouped to avoid Ululation fear; beware Tail Swipe behind.
st.d:
-Inside: burn walls/adds fast; outside: assist re-chaining immediately.
-Do not enter puddle without Mini or you’ll die.
st.h:
-One healer goes inside for DPS Rush; outside healer keeps chain carriers alive.
-Spot-heal fetter handlers and fear scatter recovery.
st.t:
-Hold Cerberus faced away; pick up Wolfsbane adds if using ABC strat.
-Help coordinate re-chaining windows while he’s slumped.

st.g:
-Feint Particle Beam: marked player kites blasts to the edge.
-Move to sides for Zero-form laser.
-Soak comet towers.
-Kill Dark Clouds/Storms before she eats them.
-Kill Hypercharged Clouds inside their boxes before Particle Beam completes.
st.d:
-If marked, run the beam wide; otherwise soak nearest tower and nuke adds fast.
-Enter a boxed zone immediately for Hypercharged Clouds.
st.h:
-Tank takes heavy autos + DoT—keep them stable during scatter mechanics.
-After add phases, prep raid healing for the follow-up raidwide.
st.t: -Keep boss steady.

185.g: Kill everything until Cerberus pukes you out.

st.g:
-Tonberry Stalkers are untargetable and will Throat Stab anyone they catch; keep moving and do not run into them.
-Treasure Hunters buy time by distracting the stalker, so do not kill them unless needed.
-This dungeon has long pull paths and light barriers; split pulls or use heavier mitigation.
st.h: -Be ready for extra damage on large pulls; this dungeon punishes overpulling more than later ARR dungeons.

st.g:
-Stay out of front. Beatdown and Moldy Sneeze are frontal, and Inhale pulls players in before Goobbue's Grief.
-If Inhale catches you, run back out immediately. Dodge Moldy Phlegm circles.
st.h:
-Esuna Reduced Immunity when possible.
-Prepare healing for anyone clipped by Goobbue's Grief or Moldy Phlegm.

st.g:
-Interrupt Fire with a stun, or move behind the boss during the cast.
-When he focuses a player, kite away to avoid Amorphic Flail.
-Kill Purple and White adds first for Paralysis and Heavy.
st.h: -Cleanse Paralysis and Heavy when possible.

st.g:
-Stay near the boss. If his target leaves melee, he uses Scourge of Nym.
-Killed Tonberries give the king Rancor, increasing Everybody's Grudge damage. Avoid killing adds unless they become a problem.
-At low HP Tonberry Slashers close in from the edges; stay away from them and finish the boss.

108.g:
-Avoid the falling aethercrystals, they explode.
Zombies will wake up after you pass over them.
-Interrupt trash mobs' Banish III cast, they can be lethal.

130.g:
-Avoid Corrupting Shot lines and stay spread to limit Corrupting Crystal stacks.
-Crystalline Shot puddles expand twice. With one puddle, use the edges; with two, split across the safe zones.
-At 3 stacks, move far away before you explode and clip others.
-Kill Zombie War Hounds quickly to reduce stack pressure.
130.h:
-Prepare healing after Giga Slash knockback and Corrupting Crystal explosions.
-If someone reaches 3 stacks, be ready for burst damage away from the group.

132.g:
-Ignore eggs until they threaten to hatch. When 2-3 glow purple, kill only one, and prioritize a spotted egg.
-Killing more than one egg triggers Flying Frenzy and can kill a player.
-If eggs hatch instead, kill the chicks.
-When Zu flies up, kill active adds and dodge the ground effects under the tank.
132.h:
-Expect repeated AoE healing through the fight.
-Be ready to recover Flying Frenzy or airborne damage if mistakes happen.

133.g:
-Move out of Bombination circles.
-Tyrant has low HP, so either AoE the Sailor adds with the boss or burn him down directly.

134.g:
-Deathly Verse must be healed to full before the timer ends or the target attacks allies.
-When Siren vanishes, she either reappears in the center for Deathly Cadenza or on an edge for Feral Lunge.
-Stay center to dodge Cadenza; move to the edges to dodge Feral Lunge.
-Kill adds quickly, especially Sergeants, which disable players they touch.
134.h: -Esuna Song of Torment bleed and Lunatic Voice Reduced Immunity.

st.g:
-Fire II drops circle AoEs.
-Fireflow sends two sets of four cardinal cones; move into the first set after it fires to avoid the second.
-Burning Bolt is the tankbuster.

-Electrify is a circle AoE around the boss.
-Levinfang is the tankbuster.
-When the water crackles with electricity for Hydroelectric Shock, move onto the dirt slopes until it resolves.

-Optional boss triggered by approaching the chest in the circular room.
-Rudius Beaks join the fight as adds, so kill or control them before they overwhelm the group.
st.t: -Pick up the Rudius Beaks quickly.

st.g:
-Straight Punch is the tankbuster.
-At about 80% and 60%, Burning Ward makes Tangata invulnerable while the torches spawn fire wisps. Kill the wisps before they reach the boss.
-Plain Pound starts as a circle, then becomes two donuts; begin outside, then move into the center after the first hit.
-Firewater drops circle AoEs.

42.g:
-Triclip is the tankbuster.
-Kill Dung Wespe adds quickly before they use Final Sting.
-Frightful Roar is a point-blank AoE that applies Physical Vulnerability Up.
-Mow is a frontal cone that inflicts Poison.
-Mortal Ray gives the whole party Doom; stun it if possible, or clear Doom by stepping on the glowing square plate.
-Tanking the boss near the middle makes the plates easier to reach.
42.h:
-Esuna Physical Vulnerability Up from Frightful Roar and Poison from Mow if needed.
-Be ready for deaths if Doom is not cleared quickly.
42.t: -Keep the boss between the plates and mitigate Triclip.

43.g:
-When the Golem Soulstone is active, the boss takes almost no damage; kill the Soulstone first.
-Destroying the Soulstone stuns Temple Guardian and makes it vulnerable for a short time.
-Rockslide is a frontal line.
-True Grit is a frontal cone that inflicts Blind.
-Boulder Clap is a frontal AoE.
-Obliterate deals party-wide damage.
-Stone Skull hits one player, knocks them back, and stuns them.
43.h: -Esuna Blind from True Grit if needed.

44.g:
-Looming Judgment is the tankbuster.
-Summoned Mythril Verges gain Haste each time they fire, and Self-Destruct at 6 stacks, so kill them quickly.
-In the chained add phase, every player is pulled to their own Verge and dies if their add survives long enough to connect with Verge Pulse.
-Free players should immediately help kill the remaining adds.
-Creeping Darkness is party-wide damage.
-Dark II is a large cone at a random player, and Dark is a circle on one player's location.
-The final Verge wave repeats the first add pattern without the chains.

52.g:
-Stone II is a circle AoE on a player's location.
-Mandible Bite is a frontal cone.
-Silence can be interrupted.
-Trap Jaws is a multi-hit melee attack on the tank.
-The boss summons Soldiers first, then a Guard, then a Marshal; later waves are only Soldiers or a Guard.
-Kill the Marshal quickly if it tethers the boss with Formic Pheromones.
52.h:
-Cleanse Silence if an interrupt is missed.
-Watch the tank during Trap Jaws and the bigger add waves.
52.t: -Pick up the Guard and Marshal quickly and keep the boss stable for add control.

96.g:
-When the worm burrows, it becomes more dangerous than when surfaced.
-Sand Pillar and Earthbreak punish anyone standing on the sand traps.
-Bottomless Desert pulls everyone toward the center; move back out before the worm emerges there.
-Sand Cyclone targets a random player and applies a damage-over-time effect.
-Sludge is a heavy single-target DoT and should be cleansed quickly.
-Spreading out while the boss is buried reduces the chance multiple players get hit together.
96.h:
-Esuna Sludge quickly.
-Be ready to heal players clipped by burrow mechanics or Bottomless Desert.
96.t: -Keep the boss steady while surfaced and be ready to re-engage after each burrow.

97.g:
-Lion's Breath is an untelegraphed frontal cleave, so the boss must face away from the party.
-The Ram's Breath hits the boss's right side with ice and Heavy; The Dragon's Breath hits its left side with lightning and Paralysis.
-When the eyes glow violet, Dragon's Voice is a donut and everyone must move in.
-When the eyes glow blue, Ram's Voice is point-blank and everyone must move out.
-Cacophony sends a marked orb to one player; if it touches anyone early it explodes and inflicts Paralysis.
-Lightning Storm drops circles on two players.
97.h: -Cleanse Paralysis and Heavy from missed breaths, Voices, or Cacophony.

50.g:
-Blustering Blink is a frontal line AoE.
-Void Matter is a sequence of wall circles, then center safe, then a final center blast. Move into the middle after the first wall set, then back out.
-Eyes on Me is raidwide damage.
50.h: -Prepare for the repeated raid damage from Eyes on Me and recover anyone clipped by Void Matter.
50.t: -Keep the boss positioned so Blustering Blink stays away from the party.

st.g:
-Straight Punch is a light melee hit.
-Double Smash is a frontal cone.
-Elbow Drop is a stronger frontal cone once the boss drops below half HP.
-Deepvoid Slaves on the elevated platforms bombard the arena.
-Firewater drops four circles around the room, while Boulderdash hits everyone instantly.

-Only the tank should stay in front of Batraal.
-When Batraal tethers to a crystal, he becomes invulnerable and starts firing Desolation at the marked target. Kill the crystal quickly.
-Desolation is an extremely dangerous line AoE; if targeted, aim it away from the party.
-The crystals activate in a fixed counter-clockwise order as the fight goes on.
-At about 30% HP after the third crystal, Hellssend gives Batraal permanent Damage Up and he starts using Desolation freely.
-Grim Halo is raidwide damage and Grim Cleaver hits a random player.

-Standing in the yellow liquid inflicts Goldbile damage-over-time.
-Gold Rush applies stacking Gold Lung, which cannot be Esuna'd; use Morbol Fruit to clear it.
-Try to stay at 2 stacks or less, but remember each fruit gives Morbid Meal and disappears for a while.
-Hundred Lashings is a heavy melee hit.
-Gold Dust drops circle AoEs under random players.

-Only the tank should stay in front of Coincounter.
-10-Tonze Swipe is a frontal hit.
-100-Tonze Swipe is the one-handed frontal cone.
-100-Tonze Swing is the two-handed point-blank AoE.
-Glower is a line laser on a random player that inflicts Paralysis.
-The ground telegraphs are visible now, but the weapon stance still tells you which big AoE is coming.
st.h:
-Cleanse Paralysis from Glower if needed.
-Be ready to recover anyone clipped by Swipe or Swing.

st.g:
-Standing in the yellow liquid inflicts Goldbile damage-over-time.
-Burrs stacks cannot be Esuna'd; eat a Morbol Fruit at about 2 to 3 stacks.
-Bad Breath is a deadly frontal cone that inflicts many debuffs at once; if hit, use a fruit immediately.
-At half HP, destroy the Strange Morbol Fruits before they hatch into seedlings.
-Vine Probe is a frontal line and Hooked Burrs / Burr Burrow add more Burr stacks over time.
st.h: -Bad Breath on the healer can snowball fast, so stay well clear of the front.

st.g:
-Platforms rise and poison fills the floor – stay on safe platforms.
-Enemy waves include Valefors, Homunculi, Greater Demons, Valar, Dira, Cursed Eyes.
st.d:
-Stay on raised platforms to avoid ground damage and cleave AoEs.
-Save AoE cooldowns for add waves attacking platforms.
st.h:
-Expect steady platform-based damage—heal accordingly.
-Watch for knockbacks—rescue or position heal through group movement.
st.t:
-Tank mobs onto safe platforms away from group.
-Face enemies outward to protect platform DPS/healers.

st.g:
-Kill skeleton adds (Platinals) before they reach boss or raid will wipe.
-When dragon revives second time, ignore Rotting Eyes and burn boss.
-Poison fills floor occasionally; use raised platforms.
-Position boss based on datacenter convention (JP = center, NA/EU = far edge).
st.d:
-Burn skeletons quickly, focus adds before they reach dragon.
-Use raised platforms to stay safe from poison.
-Ignore Rotting Eyes on last revive; full burn boss.
st.h:
-Heal through raid damage when skeletons reach boss.
-Watch tanks during add-heavy phases.
-Be ready for high AoE healing in poison phases.
st.t:
-Tank dragon at center (JP) or far edge (NA/EU) depending on group strategy.
-Pull boss near adds to simplify cleaving them.
-Ensure uptime on boss while DPS handle skeletons.

st.g:
-Split into parties A/B/C to activate platforms and expose Atomos.
-Must station 4 players per platform before barrier activates to avoid Iron Giants.
st.d:
-Go to your assigned platform and avoid crossing prematurely.
-Burst Atomos after platform activation.
st.h: -Pre-heal platform teams in case of accidental AoEs or delays.
st.t:
-Lead adds into platform DPS safe zones.
-Avoid pulling boss or adds onto platforms.

st.g:
-Players with Astral Realignment buff can damage boss.
-Without buff, focus adds attacking Magic Pots.
-Protect Pots at all costs; if they die, wipe.
st.d:
-If buffed with Astral Realignment, hit boss.
-If not, kill adds tethered to Pots immediately.
-Avoid cleave range of boss.
st.h:
-Keep Pots alive with heals.
-Cleanse damage on buffed tank holding boss.
-Spot heal players killing adds.
st.t:
-If buffed, grab boss and face away from group.
-Swap aggro when other tank gets Astral Realignment.
-Help with adds if unbuffed.

st.g:
-Kill Iron Giants before they destroy comets.
-Drop comet markers outside boss’s ring.
-Hide behind comets during Ecliptic Meteor cast.
st.d:
-Burn adds, especially Iron Giants and Puroboros.
-When marked, place comets outside boss ring.
-Use comets as LOS cover for Ecliptic Meteor.
st.h:
-Heal towers if used; otherwise focus on raidwide damage.
-Prepare for high damage during Ecliptic Meteor phase.
-Support players dropping comets.
st.t:
-Main tank keeps boss centered.
-Off tanks pick up Iron Giants, face away from raid/comets.
-Protect comets until Meteor phase.

135.g:
-Avoid standing in front of boss.
-Dodge telegraphed AoEs.
-When Ancient Flare is cast, go to assigned platform (A left, B center, C right) to create barrier.
-Kill Iron Giants and Iron Claws adds.
135.d:
-Help kill Iron Claws quickly.
-Move to assigned platform for Ancient Flare.
-Dodge AoEs and stay behind boss.
135.h:
-Heal through raid damage during Ancient Flare.
-Be ready to Rescue players late to platforms.
-Support tanks when adds spawn.
135.t:
-Face boss away from raid.
-Move group to platforms during Ancient Flare.
-Pick up Iron Giant adds and hold aggro.

st.g:
-Throws Fire Angon spears that apply stacking Burn if left on ground.
-Kill spears quickly or party-wide Burn stacks wipe the group.
st.d:
-Target and destroy spears immediately before focusing boss.
-Maintain DPS uptime between spear phases.
st.h:
-Burn stacks surge if spears linger—heal through dot ticks.
-Raid heals needed during boss plus spear overlap.
st.t:
-Face boss away from party.
-Intercept spears to prevent mid-group placement.

st.g:
-Summons colored totems; effects are unknown until first cleanse—can buff, debuff, toad, etc.
-He casts fire AoEs and Toad on random players.
st.d:
-Purify one totem at first spawn to identify effect; pick attack buff color afterward.
-Avoid totem-related damage gaps, maintain steady uptime.
st.h:
-Clear toads with that totem—time heal removal precisely.
-Manage Fire resist stacks to avoid fatal AoEs.
st.t:
-Position boss clear of totem area so purifiers can safely step in.
-Keep boss mobile to prevent standing in damaging zones.

st.g:
-Uses Tyrannic Blare frontal cone; applies Rotting Lung with linked gas circles.
-Drops Sacred Standards buffing boss—tank must kite to avoid standing in them.
-Random Doom on players, removed by full heal.
st.d:
-Stay behind boss to dodge Blare; spread during gas phase.
-Move off infected player to avoid shared damage zone.
st.h:
-Top off Lung victims and manage AoE gas overlap heals.
-Be ready for Doom removals when cast triggers.
st.t:
-Kite boss continuously to avoid standing in Standards.
-Face boss to prevent cones; lead group around gas circles.

58.en: The Binding Coil of Bahamut – Turn 2

147.g:
Head reflects ranged physical; tail reflects magic.
Melee can safely hit tail.
Burn Sahagin adds quickly before Hydroshot puddles (Dropsy).
Kill Gyre Spumes immediately to prevent Elemental Converter drain and Tidal Wave wipe.
Watch water spouts: move opposite side for Spinning Dive.
At ~60%, be ready to activate converter to block Tidal Wave.
Avoid Grand Fall AoEs (Heavy debuff).
Phase 2 adds Wavetooth Sahagins — kill fast to prevent Hysteria.
Mechanics repeat until Leviathan falls.
147.d:
Hit tail if melee.
Casters target head, ranged focus tail.
Burn Sahagin adds quickly.
Prioritize Gyre Spumes.
Avoid Grand Fall AoEs.
Move properly for Spinning Dive and Tidal Wave.
Focus boss when adds are cleared.
147.h:
Heal through tankbusters (Dread Tide).
Top party after raidwides (Tidal Roar).
Cleanse Dropsy if possible.
Extra healing after Spinning Dive knockback and Grand Fall Heavy debuff.
Prepare for chaos if Wavetooth Sahagins cast Hysteria.
147.t:
Maintain aggro on head or tail depending on party comp.
Mitigate Dread Tide tankbuster.
Pull and hold Sahagin adds.
Position properly when Leviathan dives.
Be ready for Elemental Converter timing on Tidal Wave.

401.g:
-Ifrit uses stronger versions of Eruption (targeted AoE), Radiant Plume (inner or outer AoE), and charges.
-Nail phase occurs multiple times; failing to destroy all nails results in lethal Hellfire.
-Uses Crimson Cyclone (dash) and builds toward Enrage.
401.d:
-Avoid Eruption and Radiant Plume by watching cast indicators.
-Focus all nails during nail phases—missing even one is fatal.
401.h:
-Prepare strong AoE healing after Hellfire and Crimson Cyclone.
-Watch for tank damage spikes during cleaves and Hellfire.
401.t:
-Keep Ifrit centered and faced away from party.
-Pop cooldowns for heavy hits like Infernal Surge and Hellfire.

403.g:
Dodge Landslide or risk being knocked off the platform.
Stand near the red line during Geocrush to minimize damage but avoid falling.
Watch Weight of the Land puddles and move quickly.
Bomb Boulders explode in drop order—note the sequence and dodge accordingly.
Break players free from Granite Gaol quickly.
Destroy Titan’s Heart before Earthen Fury to avoid wipe.
Avoid getting pushed off ledge at all costs.
403.d:
Stay mobile to dodge Landslide and Weight of the Land.
Kill Granite Gaols quickly when allies are trapped.
Avoid bomb explosions by tracking spawn order.
Help burn Titan’s Heart before Earthen Fury.
Don’t stand near arena edges unnecessarily.
403.h:
Prepare burst healing for Tumult (can repeat up to 7 times).
Top off the party before Geocrush.
Cleanse Damage Down from freed Gaol players.
Keep group stable during raidwide Earthen Fury.
Raise players who fall off when possible.
403.t:
Face Titan away from party to avoid cleaving.
Mitigate Mountain Buster tankbuster.
Position carefully to avoid getting knocked off by Landslide.
Hold aggro on Titan during add mechanics and heart phase.
Move Titan minimally to give DPS safe space to dodge AoEs.

39.g:
-Fight consists of three phases: initial, sisters phase, and final.
-Garuda uses Slipstream (frontal cone stun), Friction (targeted AoE), Mistral Song (tankbuster), and Eye of the Storm (donut AoE).
-Summons Suparna and Chirada during second phase—must be separated.
-Uses Wicked Wheel (point-blank AoE) and Mistral Shriek (raid-wide AoE).
39.d:
-Stay behind Garuda to avoid Slipstream and Wicked Wheel.
-Focus Suparna first when sisters appear, then switch to Chirada.
39.h:
-Prepare burst heals after Mistral Shriek.
-Watch for simultaneous tank damage from Garuda and Suparna.
39.t:
-Tank Garuda facing away from the group.
-During sister phase, split tanks: one on Suparna, one on Garuda. Keep them separated to avoid buffs.

140.g:
-Casts Darkfire, covering part of bridge and spawning a Flambeau.
-Flambeau must be killed before it reaches fire or self-destructs, wiping party.
-Stun Flambeau if necessary to buy time.

141.g:
-Improved Blasting Device spawns Waymaker Bombs; must be carried into boss path when timer nears 0.
-Black bombs spawn and self-destruct—move away.
-Sprites spawn around edges; must be killed.
-Golem uses Plaincracker cone at tank.
-After Golem dies, Biggy spawns with large bombs—move clear of blast radius.
141.d:
-One DPS handles bomb duty; drop Waymaker Bombs in Golem’s path.
-Other DPS focus adds and kill Biggy quickly.
-Stay away from exploding black bombs.
141.h:
-Top group after Plaincracker.
-Prepare AoE healing if bomb explosions clip players.

142.g:
-Boss cleaves; only tank should stand in front.
-Circular AoEs appear—dodge.
-Giga adds spawn, target random players—kill quickly.
-Sand Worm spawns periodically; place Crystallized Rock on sand to distract it.
-Failure causes Bottomless Desert: heavy raid damage and pull-in, often wiping.
142.h:
-Spot heal players targeted by Giga adds.
-Be ready for heavy AoE healing if Bottomless Desert goes off.

137.g:
-Casts Void Blizzard, applying Slow—Esuna required.
-Spawns Manor Butler adds; kill quickly.
-Places ice patches on ground—avoid standing in them.

138.g:
-Cleave attacks hit in front—non-tanks stay behind.
-Glowing spirit cutters can silence, and swirling swords cover areas—dodge promptly.
-Casts Abyssal Transfixion, inflicting Paralysis—must be cleansed.
-Spawns an add; kill quickly.

139.g:
-Spawns adds in waves; she absorbs them and casts Blood Rain—damage scales with add HP left.
-First wave: Manor Sentry (grants stun/silence immunity).
-Second wave: 2 Maidservants (grant Determination buff); one must be pushed to 0% before absorb.
-Final wave: Lady Amandine; DPS check to reduce her HP before absorption.
-At ~15% HP, casts Beguiling Mist (charms party) followed by Void Fire IV; repeats 3 times—kill before third or wipe.
139.d:
-Burn adds to 0% quickly; focus one Maidservant fully.
-STOP DPS at around 50-60% to control timing of add phases, otherwise you won't have time to kill the adds before they're absorbed.
139.h: -Prepare heavy healing for Blood Rain—damage scales with add HP.

st.g:
-Handle him like a cyclops: one hand on the mace means run through him, two hands means move away.
-Avoid Eye of the Beholder lasers.
-When 1000-Tonze Swing starts, use the lever and stand in the Mammet's blue Manawall aura to survive.

-Assign one pedestal orb to each player before pulling.
-Use your orb during Demon Eye to gain Gloam and survive.
-When the eye becomes targetable, burn it before it turns red.
-Dodge the large cone AoEs.

-Kill the healer first.
-The lancer ignores enmity and may chase random players, so kite if targeted.
-A common order is healer first, then the other fighters, leaving the gladiator late.

-Kill Mumuepo first.
-He chains players before a large AoE; the free player must use Thal's Scepter to release the chained players before it resolves.
-Narasimha has a tail swipe and targeted circles, so avoid standing behind him and move out of marked AoEs.
st.t: -Pick up both enemies and keep Narasimha faced away from the party.
st.h: -Be ready for heavy damage if the chains are not broken in time.

st.g:
-Kill monkey adds first.
-When boss pounds chest, use one Banana Tree to interrupt.
-Do not let adds eat bananas.
-Avoid Stool Pelt AoEs.

-Avoid frontal line AoEs and puddles.
-Only enter bubbles when boss submerges for Whirlpool.
-Do not touch bubbles early.
-Move away from boss path during Tunnel.

-Kill 10 arms across platforms (2 per platform).
-Use Waterspouts to move but avoid stacking debuff.
-When marked with green icon, move to another platform, drop tornado, return.
-Focus Tentacles when they spawn—they are higher priority than arms.

-Illuminati Snipers tether to random players, dealing continuous damage; players can intercept the tether to protect the target
-Spiked bombs explode in line AoEs toward cardinals
-Bomb Toss targets random players with circular AoEs
st.t: -Pick up and intercept sniper tethers when possible to protect weaker allies

st.g:
-Ceruleum puddles expand over time and explode during Oversurge
-Drill Cannons fires a line AoE at a random player
-Career targets a player with crosshairs and rushes them shortly after; avoid line of charge
-Needle Burst: party-wide AoE
-Illuminati Glider adds cast Bomb Toss, leaving circular AoEs

-Flamethrower cleaves the main target
-Bombardment drops circular AoEs on random players
-At 75%, 50%, and 25% HP boss circles arena; avoid its path and kill Illuminati Sniper and Glider adds
-When bombs cover arena, push them out using AoEs
-Giant Bomb needs to be killed quickly or you wipe.
-Boss charges through middle after Giant Bomb.

-Targeted players with Prey will be Devoured, free them by attacking the Voracious Maw
-Avoid standing in persistent AoE pools on the ground

-Boss will only attack players with Scale Flakes debuff
-Ensure tank is the one to receive stacks by standing in front of Ranch Wamoura when it dies

152.g:
-Two doors with the same symbol need to be memorized when the fight starts.
-The doors should be opened just before Omen finishes casting.
-The party's invulnerable while traveling between the doors, keeping you safe from Omen.
-When marked, move away from the party.

st.g:
-Uses Swinge and Rake (cone cleave), plus Lion’s Breath frontal AoEs.
-Spawns Vigil Heirs that explode on death and buff boss if too close.
st.d:
-Kite adds away from boss before killing; DPS drag them to opposite side.
-Avoid boss’s cleaves by staying at flank/rear and maintain uptime.
st.h:
-Healer should stack off to let DPS clear adds safely; avoid healer-focused add explosion AoEs.
-Expect spike when adds die near boss—heal accordingly.
st.t:
-Corner-tank boss and face away to redirect cleaves.
-Do not pick up adds—let DPS handle, tank boss only.

st.g:
-Party uses corner cannons to damage boss and adds.
-Boss turtling (Diamondback) reflects cannon shots; Hard Stomp must be interrupted with stun shot.
st.d:
-Use Iron Kiss normally; switch to cannon stun (Spindly Finger) during Hard Stomp.
-Help clean adds once turtling ends.
st.h:
-Rotate two stunners to safely interrupt Hard Stomp.
-Keep NPCs healed—if all die, boss performs uninterruptible wipe Stomp.
st.t:
-Stay close to cannon platform; face boss so party can aim lines safely.
-Keep DPS on boss once Stomp interrupted and adds are handled.

st.g:
-Random combo of shoulder tackle, tail swipe, claw swipe; applies Infirmity debuff.
-At 60%, a clone spawns and adds fireball and breath.
st.d:
-Stay at flank to dodge cleaves and tail swings.
-During phase 2, kill original boss first, then burn clone.
st.h:
-Anticipate cleave spikes and Infirmity reducing heal efficiency.
-Heal burst after Fireball/Breath; reposition quickly.
st.t:
-Maintain flank positioning; kite boss to keep safe zone.
-Keep aggro on original during second phase until dead.

st.g:
-Avoid Bitter End frontal cone
-Spread to reduce Pradamante splash damage
-If Toaded, kite Enkidu until debuff ends
-If Mini'd, run while Gilgamesh chases
-Heal Confused players to full HP to remove debuff
-Lethal: Being caught by Enkidu while Toaded, or chased while Mini'd, can kill quickly
st.t:
-Face Bitter End away from group
-Position boss away from party when using frontal attacks
st.d:
-Dodge Bitter End cone and Pradamante
-If targeted with Toad or Mini, kite boss or Enkidu until safe
st.h:
-Heal through Pradamante damage
-Top off Confused players immediately to clear debuff
-Watch for Toad/Mini targets, keep them safe until debuffs expire

st.g:
-Avoid Whirlwind Slash AoE
-Dodge Giga Jump marker by moving away from others
-Stay clear of Whirlwinds on the ground, touching them causes explosions
-Lethal: Multiple debuffs (Toad/Mini) at once can overwhelm healers
st.t:
-Keep boss faced away from party
-Position boss away from Whirlwinds
-Pick up stray adds if any spawn
st.d:
-Dodge Whirlwind Slash, Giga Jump, and ground Whirlwinds
-Kite Enkidu if Toaded
-Be extra cautious while Mini'd to avoid AoEs
st.h:
-Heavy healing needed when multiple players are afflicted by Toad/Mini
-Top off after Whirlwind Slash and Giga Jump
-Maintain regens to cover sustained debuff pressure

st.g:
-Target the glowing red core on its limbs — disabling each spawns adds, then repeat until boss is vulnerable.
-Avoid Shifting Sands whirlpools that drag you under (instant death).
-Move out of sand spheres dropped on marked players (Dust to Dust).
st.d:
-Focus the orb-carrying limb immediately to progress phases.
-Dodge sands quickly to maintain uptime.
st.h:
-Provide raid-wide healing during add phases when limbs break.
-Keep players topped and mobile to survive sinking and sphere hits.
st.t:
-Hold adds away from the boss when they spawn.
-Position boss so party has clear space to avoid whirlpools.

st.g: Pick up spheres as you go through the duty, you'll need them later.

-Clears waves of Sabotenders; a Guardia add shields the boss and must be killed immediately.
-Interrupt the boss’s 100,000 Needles by dealing burst damage after Guardia dies.
-Deal with moderate AoEs (3,000 Needles) along the way.
st.d:
-Kill Guardia on spawn before continuing to boss.
-Burst DPS at the start of Needles cast to interrupt.
st.h:
-Shield/damage-mitigate when 3,000 Needles hits party.
-Focus burst healing around the interrupt window.
st.t:
-Pull adds around the boss but keep them off DPS while focusing the boss.
-Ensure Guardia is tanked immediately for swift takedown.

st.g:
-Mummies spawn, applying Curse of the Mummy; avoid being hit to prevent stacking to 4 stacks (auto-mummification).
-Boss uses Light of Anathema (random line) and Flurry of Rage (cleave), both giving Curse stacks if hit.
-Boss tethers a player—tethered player accumulates Curse stacks unless boss is stunned or distances.
-Avoid mummy lines crossing edges.
st.d:
-Move out of boss’s line-of-sight when casting Light of Anathema.
-Stun boss on tether cast to prevent tether stacking into mummification.
st.h:
-Dispel mummy curse before reaching 4 stacks to avoid mummification.
-Heal quickly when players are hit by mummy lines or boss cleaves.
st.t:
-Face boss away from party for Flurry of Rage.
-Stun boss when tethering initiates, or kite tethered player away to cut stacking.

158.g:
-Trash pull through packs of enemies; no major mechanics.
-Group pulls for AoE are ideal.
158.d:
-Stay stacked with AoE group to burst quickly.
-Help stun occasional adds to speed clear.
158.h:
-Heal through steady minor damage; no burst phases.
-Stay mobile as party moves between pulls.
158.t:
-Pull tightly and position packs centrally.
-Keep aggro on all mobs for AoE uptime.

159.g:
-Blue (ice), red (fire), and purple (lightning) orbs tether random players to pillars.
-Use interplay of orbs and water pools to mitigate Ancient Flare.
159.d: -Avoid frontal cleaves and kite orb appropriately: lightning to pillars, fire to thaw ice.
159.h:
-Watch frozen players and regen/shield them pre-thaw.
-Keep party topped for Ancient Flare, stand in puddle if available.
159.t:
-Tank centrally or north for space.
-Face Scylla away from group and manage add cleaves.

160.g: -Trash-heavy with a Green Dragon divebomb that poisons and spawns clones.
160.d:
-Stun Doga/Unei clones with AoE stuns to reduce pressure.
-Kill clones quickly to prevent poison buildup.
160.h:
-Provide healing for poison DoTs from dragon.
-Watch for clone auto-attacks and use shields.
160.t: -Hold clones and burn evenly; kite dragon knockback safely.

161.g:
-Spawned Clockwork Wright adds connect to boss with energy beams; block connections to prevent buffs.
-Intermission launches teams to outer platforms to clear adds.
161.d:
-Avoid electrical fields next to Wrights.
-Stack on platforms, burn adds, and return via jump pads.
161.h:
-Heal through add damage and AoE bursts on platforms.
-Be ready for electrified ground and intermission transitions.
161.t:
-Tank boss centrally; do not pull Wrights.
-Move to platforms after jump and hold adds.

162.g: -Red Dragon divebombs players marked with green marker; otherwise straightforward.
162.d:
-Move out from divebomb target marker promptly.
-Maintain uptime outside divebomb windows.
162.h:
-Heal divebomb damage and spread for cleave phases.
-Top up party immediately afterward.
162.t:
-Tank cleanses front/back; kite dragon away from group.
-Lead dragon away from active bomb zones.

163.g:
-Spawns Experiment adds; some tethered orbs that shrink Kum Kum when grouped.
-Curtain Call: hide behind ice-blocked players.
-If you're a frog, don't use your fire attack on the ice, it'll melt and leave no where to hide from Curtain Call.
163.d:
-Stun Experiment adds then burn quickly.
-Kite purple orb into Kum Kum add to shrink it.
163.h:
-Esuna bomb debuffs and heal toads/Others.
-Keep non-frog players healed and positioned for Curtain Call.
163.t:
-Tank boss centrally; pick up adds safely.
-Face away and hold adds during orb phases.

164.g:
-Yellow circle Aspects must be occupied; Aetherochemical Explosion orbs need soaking.
-Ancient Quaga: levitation pads spawn from stack markers; hide on pads.
164.d:
-Stand in yellow circles and soak explosion orbs early.
-Stack with party for Quaga pads and use LB if available.
164.h:
-Manage raid spread and AoE heals through circle mechanics.
-Support levitation stack phase and burst heal between bursts.
164.t:
-Tank at center, bait cleaves into empty space.
-Face boss away, position orbs for soaks, and guide party to pads.

st.g:
-Do not attack zombies; killing them applies a stacking partywide damage resistance debuff that lasts one minute and can stack up to 8 times
-When a red/orange arrow appears above a player’s head, that player must run into the zombie horde to trigger an AoE that kills them safely
-Players should stay grouped in the middle so the marked player is always near the kited zombies
-DPS should focus damage between zombie waves to shorten the fight
st.t:
-Maintain boss aggro in the center and keep her attention away from the group
-Do not interfere with zombie mechanics; hold position and manage boss placement
st.d:
-Never attack the zombie adds
-When marked with a red arrow, run into the zombie horde to detonate them
-Group mid to ensure AoE clears the adds efficiently
st.h:
-Keep party topped off during AoE detonations
-Spot heal the player being chased by zombies
-Avoid unnecessary movement to stay central for healing coverage

st.g:
-Protect Paiyo Reiyo at all costs; if he dies, the party wipes
-Boss grows stronger whenever Paiyo takes damage
-Nameless Spirits (small orbs) and later Nameless Souls (large orbs) spawn from portals and move toward Paiyo; intercept and detonate them before they reach him
-Boss leaves Bleed zones on the floor; keep her positioned at the edge of the room so the NPC is never hit
st.t:
-Tank boss at the edge of the room to prevent Bleed zones from reaching Paiyo
-Pull boss away from orb paths when possible
st.d:
-Run through and destroy orbs before they reach the NPC
-Burn boss during downtime between orb waves
-Avoid standing in lingering Bleed zones
st.h:
-Watch for partywide chip damage from orb detonations
-Top off Paiyo immediately if he takes a hit
-Be ready for sustained healing if multiple orbs slip through

st.g:
-Edda stands in the center creating a Bleed zone; do not stand in it
-She summons demons that fire line AoEs converging on the tank—avoid standing in front of boss
-Crawling zombies spawn from the arena edges and move toward the center; if any reach it, runes light up and strengthen the boss’s Red Wedding attack
-Allowing too many runes to activate can cause a lethal Red Wedding cast
st.t:
-Keep boss faced away from the group to reduce line AoE overlap
-Move slightly to avoid converging demon AoEs while maintaining control
st.d:
-Prioritize killing crawling zombie adds before they reach the center
-Spread out to intercept zombies from multiple spawn points
-Avoid line AoEs from summoned demons
st.h:
-Heal through moderate AoE pressure and Bleed damage
-Prepare burst heals if any zombies reach center and Red Wedding powers up
-Top off tank after overlapping line attacks

166.g:
-Shock Strike tankbuster—stay clear of MT.
-Thunderspark AoEs also break Chaotic Strike stuns.
-Collect Lightning Orbs to gain Surge Protection (3 orbs) but leave some for mechanics.
-Chaotic Strike stuns random player until freed by AoEs.
-Grey Arbiters spawn—kill immediately before Judgment Bolt.
-Rolling Thunder tethers two players; one must soak 3 orbs to cancel.
166.d:
-Focus Arbiters quickly on spawn.
-Spread during Thunderstorm to avoid overlapping damage.
-If tethered, coordinate who soaks orbs.
166.h:
-Prepare heavy heals if orbs are mismanaged (Ramuh hits harder).
-Free stunned players with AoEs or coordinate Thunderstorm placement.
-Top raid before Judgment Bolt.
166.t:
-Keep Ramuh faced away; Shock Strike cleaves.
-Pick up Arbiters instantly.
-Avoid standing near party to prevent tankbuster splash.

173.g:
-Shiva rotates through unarmed, staff, and sword stances. Failing mechanics gives stacking Vulnerability Up.
-In unarmed form, face her away; her autos cleave. Staff form uses Hailstorm spreads and Absolute Zero raidwide.
-Sword form uses Icebrand, Heavenly Strike knockback, and Glacier Bash frontal stun. On Hard, Icebrand is not shared; face it away and mitigate.
-Icicle Impact first uses five circles with four safe spots, then later a sequential nine-circle pattern.
-During the add phase, kill the Ice Soldiers before Diamond Dust resolves.
-In Phase 2, touching the edge freezes you, and Permafrost gives Thin Ice so stay still unless you must move.
173.d:
-Spread for Hailstorm and dodge both Icicle Impact patterns cleanly.
-Help kill Ice Soldiers quickly so Diamond Dust does not wipe the party.
173.h:
-Prepare raid healing for Absolute Zero and Diamond Dust.
-Watch for knockback mistakes, Thin Ice mistakes, and sharp tank damage from Icebrand.
173.t:
-Keep Shiva away from the party at all times.
-Mitigate and face Icebrand away in sword stance.
-Group and hold the Ice Soldiers during the add phase.

st.g:
- Aqua Balls apply Slime DoT; spread loosely so Slime does not overlap onto multiple players.
- Prey can be passed by touching another player; the Prey holder is stunned before Tail Screw.
- Tail Screw drops a non-tank to 1% HP, but kills them if Slime is still active.
st.d:
- Avoid stacking Aqua Balls on other players.
- If needed, take Prey from the tank so the tank can stun Tail Screw.
st.h:
- Cleanse Slime from everyone before Tail Screw.
- Priority is Slime cleanses, then tank HP, then party HP.
st.t:
- Pass Prey to a nearby DPS if you need to stay free to stun Tail Screw.
- Keep your HP high and stun Tail Screw if possible.

st.g:
- Kill Captain's Guard adds as soon as they spawn.
- After Madison charges and knocks a player back, burn him to stop his gunfire.
- At low HP he summons many adds and runs away.
st.d:
- Dump damage into Madison when he starts shooting; he stops after taking enough damage.
- Group in the center for the third and final add waves, then AoE them down.
st.h:
- Heal the player Madison shoots until the party deals enough damage.
- Be ready for add-wave damage near the end.
st.t: - Gather add waves so the party can AoE them down.

st.g:
- When only Kraken and Tentacles are up, attack Kraken and ignore Tentacles.
- When Kraken's Arms are up, kill the Arms and ignore Tentacles.
- When six Arms are up, focus on surviving.
st.d:
- Prioritize Kraken's Arms when they spawn.
- Otherwise attack Kraken and ignore Tentacles.
st.h:
- Ink Jet blinds players; cleanse Blind before returning to normal healing.
- Expect heavy damage when multiple Arms are active.
st.t: - Keep the fight controlled while DPS swaps between Kraken and Arms.

187.g:
-Odin uses cleaves, frontal cones, and circle AoEs frequently. At intervals, he vanishes and returns with Sanngetall (massive line AoEs), and summons spectral adds.
-Final phase includes Zantetsuken, a room-wide instant-kill if not interrupted with sufficient damage.
187.d:
-Avoid all AoEs and burn spectral adds quickly when they appear.
-Save burst for Zantetsuken cast—failure to interrupt leads to wipe.
187.h:
-Prepare group healing for Sanngetall AoEs and spectral adds.
-Top off party before Zantetsuken and mitigate incoming damage.
187.t:
-Tank Odin center and face him away from the group.
-Grab spectral adds immediately and use mitigation during Zantetsuken window.

st.g:
-At 80%, spread and absorb orbs. Alternate between big (physical vuln) and small (magic vuln).
-Kill small adds quickly; they do cone AoEs.
-Each orb hitting boss gives him a stack—at 7 stacks, non-tanks die.
-Stack for heals if holding 3+ stacks.
st.d:
-Alternate orb soaking to avoid stacking vulnerabilities.
-Kill adds fast to reduce raid damage.
-Avoid letting boss get stacks.
st.h:
-Prepare AoE heals when group soaks orbs.
-Cleanse damage after add cones.
-Heal through Sacred Soil windows if stacks accumulate.
st.t:
-Position boss for easy orb soaking.
-Mitigate damage when stacks climb.
-Hold boss steady during add phase.

st.g:
-Boss casts Double/Triple, then Spark twice/thrice.
-Tank swap with Provoke + Shirk to handle double/triple Spark.
-At 40%, orbs return—handle like Phase 1.
-Dodge End of Days (line AoE).
st.d:
-Avoid unnecessary orb stacks.
-Respect Spark—let tanks handle via swaps.
st.h:
-Prepare strong single-target heals for Spark hits.
-Top up group before orbs return.
st.t:
-Swap during Double Spark.
-Manage cooldowns across Sparks.

208.g: -Tanks handle dropping rocks, focus on clearing otherwise.
208.t: -In void, stand in circles with dropping rock and tank the damage. Not tanking these will cause a wipe.

st.g:
-Prelude to Slaughter: long cast sequence with multiple AoEs, move into safe spots
-Slaughter: cross fire AoEs + purple circle markers, spread to avoid overlap
-Adds at 60%: kill Moon Gana first before Falling Laughter completes or swords will drop
-Lethal: 3 or more swords left before Chandrahas will wipe the party with Laughing Moon stacks
-Chandrahas + Laughing Moon: heavy raidwide, healers must mitigate and top party
st.t:
-Keep Ravana faced away from raid to avoid cleaves
-Pick up adds quickly so DPS can kill Moon Gana safely
-Be ready to mitigate Chandrahas damage
st.d:
-Prioritize Moon Gana before Falling Laughter finishes
-Dodge linear and cross AoE patterns
-Spread with purple circle markers during Slaughter
-Save limit break if needed to finish adds before Chandrahas
st.h:
-Prepare raidwide healing for Prelude/Slaughter AoE chains
-Top the group before Chandrahas + Laughing Moon
-Use mitigation cooldowns during heavy AoEs
-Be ready for spike damage if adds succeed in casting Falling Laughter

st.g:
-No more Prelude to Slaughter; introduces Pillars of Heaven, Surpanakha, Rose of Hate
-Pillars of Heaven: knockback, can push you off after wall breaks
-Surpanakha: multiple linear AoEs on off-tank, avoid path
-Rose of Hate: spread to detonate safely
-Atma-Linga: raidwide AoE, may be cast twice
st.t:
-Position Ravana away from raid as always
-Be mindful of Pillars knockback angles; aim for walls
-Kite Surpanakha AoEs away from party if targeted
-Maintain aggro stability through stance swaps
st.d:
-Spread when targeted by white icons during Swift Slaughter dash
-Move into safe zones during Slaughter and Swift Slaughter AoEs
-If tethered by Rose orb, move away and take detonation solo
-Adjust to avoid falling from Pillars knockback once walls are broken
st.h:
-Heal through raidwides (Atma-Linga, Pillars, Rose detonation)
-Be ready for double Atma-Linga casts in succession
-Cover damage spikes from Swift Slaughter dash hits
-Sustain tank through repeated Surpanakha hits

st.g:
-Avoid circle AoEs and frontal cones (Wooly Inspiration).
-Share damage from Rout by standing between boss and target.
st.d:
-Preposition between boss and target to help share Rout.
-Stay mobile for fast AoE patterns.
st.h:
-Rout can catch players out of position—watch for sudden spikes.
-Minimal raid-wide damage otherwise.
st.t:
-Face away from group to avoid clipping them with cones.
-Stand near Rout target to share damage safely.

st.g:
-Spawns adds at 90% and 60% via Brain Drain.
-Separate boss and adds to avoid buffs; avoid Death Spiral donut AoE and knockbacks.
st.d:
-Switch to adds immediately when they spawn.
-Stay center during Death Spiral to avoid donut damage.
st.h:
-Heal tank heavily during add phases; boss buffs can spike damage.
-Watch positioning for knockbacks and AoEs.
st.t:
-Drag boss away from adds during spawn to prevent buffing.
-Interrupt Brain Drain if possible to delay adds.

st.g:
-Hide behind rubble for Whirling Gaol push.
-Dodge Alpine Draft and Freefall jumps.
st.d:
-Stand near rubble before Whirling Gaol.
-Use sprint to reposition after Freefall jumps.
st.h:
-Whirling Gaol push can scatter party—be ready to reposition.
-AoE spikes after jumps may require burst healing.
st.t:
-Position boss near rubble preemptively.
-Prepare to quickly regain aggro after forced movement.

3695.g: Hide behind a pile of rubble or you get pulled.

235.g:
-Avoid adds' knockback
-When Bismarck dives at the platform, shield generators reduce damage taken.
-When harpoons become active, use them immediately to chain Bismarck and board him
-Dodge tornadoes and exploding bubbles while killing adds; Bismarck’s AoE will wipe if adds are still alive
-Two Vapor Bubbles will spawn: during thunder weather, do not kill them or lightning will hit players
    -During rain, kill them quickly
235.t: -After Chitin breaks, SEPARATE adds and face them from the group - they cleave.
235.d: -During thunder, avoid killing Vapor Bubbles; during rain, kill them fast
235.h:
-Prepare strong healing during lightning strikes if timing fails
-Carapace back DoT can only be healed if you're on Bismarck's back too.

st.g:
-Lightning Storm: 4 players get small circles; the other 4 get ground AoEs—spread cleanly
-Ascalon’s Mercy: line gaps—sidestep
-Ancient Quaga: raidwide
-Ascalon’s Might: heavy tank hit
-Knights of the Round: rotating Knight cameos (charges, columns, towers). Stand on all 3 platforms for Hermenost.
-Dragon’s Gaze: turn away
st.h: -Cleanse Bleeds and Paralysis from getting hit by knights.

st.g:
-The Knights attacks are mostly obvious. Notable ones:
-Heavensflame circles + towers (Hermenost): stand on towers
-Zephirin: damage scales by his HP - burn him
-Janlenoux/Adelphel: tank damage + Holiest of Holy raid-wide
-Ignasse: proximity — move far
-Blue ice markers: drop at edge
-Comets + central meteor — kill quickly
-Guerrique: rotating ring AoE — move into rock rows to avoid.
-Thordan autos with Damage Down — put him out of his misery.

-Mini-boss that spawns Sturm Doll adds stacking boss damage.
-Off-tank should pick up adds and face them away from the group (they cleave).

-Oppressor spawns Alarum adds that leave Minimize puddles when killed under laser beams.
-Second copy (Oppressor 0.5) joins; both must die simultaneously or remaining one self-destructs.

4377.g: Marked player gets shot with several missiles.

255.g:
-Eight waves of Gordian enemies advance; bombs begin dropping from wave 4 onward.
-Party can pilot Magitek Gobwalkers to drag bombs and apply Vulnerability to enemies.
255.d:
-Use Gobwalker to pull bombs away from party corner; DPS inside to maintain uptime.
-Prioritize kill order: Magitek Gobwalkers → Jagd Dolls → Hardhelms/Hardminds → Soldiers/Snipers → Gobwidow.
255.h:
-Steady AoE healing during waves; watch for bombs’ splash damage stacks.
-Help heal Gobwalker users and bomb-affected players.
255.t:
-Split tank sides; main tank holds spam on one side, off-tank on other.
-Pick up Gobwidows separately to control AoE and vulnerability stack.

st.g:
- The arena edge stuns, damages, and paralyzes; keep away from it.
- Protean Wave fires several knockback cones. Sidestep the telegraphs.
- Sluice marks 4 players to spread, then extra ground circles appear under random players.
- The boss cleaves the main tank; avoid standing in front.
st.d:
- Stay behind the boss and away from Sluice-marked players.
- Dodge Protean Wave cones quickly so the knockback does not send you into the edge.
st.h:
- Splash is light raid damage cast 3 times in a row.
- Watch Sluice spreads and follow-up circles for overlap damage.
st.t: - Tank the boss near center and face the cleave away from the raid.

st.g:
- The hand cleave is heavy and must be shared by both tanks.
- Wash Away knocks each player in a random direction; stand center or use knockback immunity.
- After the split, both hands cleave and apply Blunt Resistance Down.
st.d:
- Return to center before Wash Away.
- Stay out from between the hands and avoid their cleave paths.
st.h:
- Top the party before Wash Away and recover anyone knocked toward the edge.
- Watch both tanks after the hand split.
st.t:
- Stack both tanks for the shared hand cleave.
- After the split, each tank takes one hand and faces it away from the raid and the other tank.

st.g:
- The boss is invulnerable and surrounded by a damaging water pool.
- Kill Gear and Piston Lubricants before they reach the edge; stun Piston rushes.
- Orange tether should be passed to a tank, who moves away before it resolves.
- Magnetic icons: same signs stack near center; opposite signs spread apart.
st.d:
- Kill Gear Lubricants quickly and focus Piston Lubricants before they reach the edge.
- Handle magnetic icons correctly to avoid collision, Atrophy, or being pushed into danger.
st.h:
- Prepare healing if adds reach the edge or magnetic icons are failed.
- Top the tethered tank before and after the heavy tether hit.
st.t:
- Take the orange tether from the marked player and move away from everyone.
- Stun Piston Lubricants when they begin rushing toward the edge.

st.g:
- Cascade deals damage and drops 3 large static pools; do not stand in them or get knocked into them.
- Magnetic icons return: same signs stack, opposite signs spread, and aim movement away from pools and the edge.
- The tank cleave now applies Blunt Resistance Down.
st.d:
- Dodge Cascade pools and magnetic movement safely.
- Stay behind the boss and avoid being knocked into pools or the edge.
st.h:
- Heal Cascade damage and sustained final-phase damage.
- Watch tanks during swaps and Blunt Resistance Down stacks.
st.t:
- Swap around 4-5 Blunt Resistance Down stacks.
- Keep the boss away from Cascade pools and face the cleave away from the raid.

4855.g: Cascade damage and 3 large static pools. Avoid the pools and knockbacks into them.
4855.h: Heal Cascade damage and watch players moving around pools.
4855.t: Keep the boss away from Cascade pools.

4858.g: Magnetic icons: same signs stack near center; opposite signs spread apart.
4858.h: Watch for collision damage and Atrophy from failed magnetic movement.

4861.h: Watch the tank after the cleave.
4861.t: Face the cleave away from the raid.

4862.h: Watch the tank after the cleave.
4862.t: Face the cleave away from the raid.

4846.t: Face the cleave away from the raid.

4853.t: Face the cleave away from the raid.

4848.g: Several knockback cones. Sidestep the telegraphs and avoid the electric edge.

4850.g: Four marked players spread out, then everyone dodges the follow-up ground circles.
4850.h: Watch for Sluice overlap and follow-up circle damage.

4847.g: Light raid-wide damage, usually repeated 3 times.
4847.h: Heal through the repeated Splash hits.

4854.g: Orange tether should be passed to a tank, who moves away before the AoE resolves.
4854.h: Top the tethered tank before and after the heavy hit.
4854.t: Take the orange tether and move away from the group.

4863.g: Random-direction knockback. Stand center or use knockback immunity.
4863.h: Recover players knocked toward the electric edge.

st.g:
- Spread out: most boss attacks deal splash damage.
- Focus one leg at a time; the other leg heals when one is destroyed.
- Blue orb target: other players intercept incoming orbs, taking 1-2 each.
- Quarantined players must kill their add; deaths in that room cannot be revived.
st.d:
- Focus the chosen leg and save burst for the boss vulnerability after it dies.
- Help intercept orbs, but avoid taking too many.
st.h:
- Heal orb soakers and spread splash damage.
- Prepare raid healing for the transition AoE after the leg dies.
st.t: - Off tank and main tank should take most orbs, depending on current HP.

st.g:
- Laser lines: the targeted player stops moving, and other players intercept at least 2 lines.
- No player should take more than 1 laser hit.
- Jagd Dolls are top priority. Keep them separated because their AoE stacks Luminous Aetheroplasm.
- Four Luminous Aetheroplasm stacks kills the player.
st.d:
- Kill Jagd Dolls immediately and keep assigned dolls separated.
- Be ready to replace assigned players if they are Quarantined.
st.h:
- Watch doll tanks and laser intercepts for splash damage.
- Heal the transition AoE after the second leg dies.
st.t: - Keep the boss stable while assigned players handle dolls and lasers.

st.g:
- All earlier mechanics except dolls and Quarantine return.
- Carnage Zero targets random players with heavy splash damage; stay spread.
- Discoid resolves as 4 ground AoEs, then 4 more, then a heavy tank hit.
- Healers with Judgement Nisi must stay far apart until stacks fall off.
st.d:
- Stay spread for splash damage and Discoid circles.
- Keep pressure on the boss while avoiding healer Nisi positions.
st.h:
- Judgement Nisi goes on both healers; stay far from the other healer and sustain yourself.
- Use cooldowns for Discoid's tank hit as fight damage ramps.
st.t:
- Mitigate the Discoid tank hit after the two sets of player AoEs.
- Use stronger cooldowns as the fight goes longer.

3939.g: Heavy splash damage on targeted players. Stay spread.
3939.h: Top targeted players after splash damage.

3934.g: Heavy splash damage on random players. Stay spread.
3934.h: Prepare healing for random heavy splash hits.

3937.g: Discoid: 4 ground AoEs, then 4 more, then a heavy tank hit.
3937.d: Dodge the Discoid circles and stay spread.
3937.h: Heal the AoEs and cover the tank hit after them.
3937.t: Mitigate the tank hit after the two Discoid AoE sets.

5053.g: Judgement Nisi on both healers. Healers must stay far apart while stacks fall off.
5053.d: Avoid standing near the healers during Judgement Nisi.
5053.h: Stay far from the other healer and sustain yourself through Nisi damage.

269.g:
-Electric Swipe: cone from rear with Electrocution debuff.
-Immersion: raidwide AoE + orbs that drop puddles (Dropsy).
-Symbiosis: spawns Hybodus adds, boss untargetable until they die.
-Hydrobomb: boss chases marked player, dropping AoEs.
-Electric Whorl: ring AoE, safe in hitbox.
-Expulsion: circle AoE with knockback and Windburn.
-Hydrocore: split-party mechanic; kill Hydrocore inside while outside group kills Hydrospheres to stop buffs.
269.d:
-Stay behind boss but avoid rear cone.
-Kite Hydrobomb safely, away from allies.
-Burn adds quickly during Symbiosis/Hydrocore.
269.h:
-Cleanse Electrocution/Dropsy if possible.
-Strong AoE healing after Immersion and Expulsion.
-Sustain group split during Hydrocore phase.
269.t:
-Face boss away to keep rear cone off group.
-Pick up Hydrocore if tanked inside barrier.

271.g:
-Tether mechanic: health equalizes if difference too large.
-Each boss gains random resistance (Magic or Ranged invuln).
-Mucus Bomb/Spray: AoEs that tether and seize targets; allies must break.
-Shockwave Stomp: hide behind Irminsul or take lethal.
-Sawtooth Feeds: adds spawn; failure leads to devour mechanic spreading Parasite.
-Pulse of the Void: small AoE poison from Irminsul.
271.d:
-Target the boss you can damage (respect resistance).
-Spread for Mucus Bomb and free tethered allies.
-Kill Ark Keds to prevent Parasite spread.
271.h:
-Cleanses for Poison/Seized debuffs.
-Heavy heals needed after Shockwave Stomp.
-Extra healing if Parasite infestations spread.
271.t:
-Each tank hold one boss apart.
-Face Sawtooth away for cleaves.
-Position Irminsul to shield party during Stomp.

st.g:
-Everyone starts with permanent Bleed.
-Corrosive Bile: cone DoT + Poison.
-Flailing Tentacles: diagonal line AoEs with Concussion debuff.
-Idol of Impurity: adds increase Bleed stacks until killed.
-Void Pact: portals spawn Foobars; boss gains Stoneskin buffs.
-Beckon + Devour: pulls Foobars in to eat, empowering boss.
-Bile Below: instant-kill unless standing on raised platforms.
-Pestilence: heavy AoE, reduced by raised platforms.
-Black Lung: adds another Bleed + Black Phlegm orbs that must be cleared before they explode.
st.d:
-Dodge diagonal tentacle slams.
-Help clear orbs during Black Lung.
-Focus Foobars and Idols quickly to avoid wipes.
st.h:
-Bleed is constant—maintain baseline healing.
-Heal through Poison/Concussion.
-Be ready for massive damage if Pestilence empowered.
st.t:
-Face boss away to avoid cone cleave.
-Pick up Gyrtower/Idol adds immediately.

st.g:
-Sickle Strike: tankbuster.
-Sickle Slash: side cleaves, safe in front/back.
-Demonic Descent: either stack marker or random large AoEs.
-Nemesis Burst: circular cleave + knockback.
-Abyssal Reaper: cleave with knockback + Vulnerability Up.
-Petrifaction: gaze, turn away.
-Add Phase: splits into Echidna/Sinister/Dexter—each tank grabs one, keep apart to prevent buffs.
-Gehenna: raidwide after adds merge.
-Bloodguards: occasional adds.
st.d:
-Stack for descent marker or dodge scattered AoEs.
-Avoid gaze; reposition if knocked back.
-Burn adds quickly in split phase.
st.h:
-Tankbusters + Vulnerability Up require spot heals.
-Raid healing for Gehenna and Demonic Descent AoEs.
st.t:
-Main tank takes Echidna, other tanks grab Sinister/Dexter.
-Keep adds apart to prevent buffs.
-Swap only if Vulnerability stacks too high.

5178.g: Get out of the tentacles' way.

5183.g: Foobars will spawn on the raised platforms - kill ASAP.

5181.g: Instakill - stand on raised platforms to avoid.

5182.g: Touch spawned orbs to defuse or get massive debuffs.

5142.g: Rectangular AoEs to left and right - safe in middle.

st.g:
-Avoid breath attacks from both the boss and small adds
-Boss spins clockwise or counterclockwise during breath; move behind or opposite direction
-Rose Hips spawn from second spin onward; kill them quickly before they explode and cause raidwide damage
st.t: -Face boss away from group to control breath direction
st.d: -Focus down Rose Hip adds immediately
st.h:
-Prepare AoE heals after breath attacks or Rose Hip explosions
-Watch for players clipped by stray breath cones

st.g:
-Bees around the arena target random players with column AoEs; avoid standing in front of them
-During Ally, bees form two groups and perform double untelegraphed line AoEs; watch their positions to dodge in time
-Knight Hawk adds tether to boss; kill quickly to stop stacking raidwide damage
-Avail: while adds are alive boss is immune, does AoEs, and stacks Damage Up.
st.t:
-Keep boss centered to simplify add management
-Move slightly to dodge Ally columns and maintain uptime
st.d:
-Avoid all frontal lines from bees
-Focus Knight Hawk adds before continuing boss damage
st.h: -Prepare to burst heal players lingering in bee line AoEs.

273.g:
-Initial large AoE can only be dodged by standing close to the boss
-Bulbs spawn and place yellow AoEs that apply Magic Vulnerability Up debuffs
-Frond Fatale charms players facing boss, forcing them into AoEs; look away.
273.t: -Position boss center to help melee dodge inward safely

st.g:
-Fiendish Rage: stack on marked player to share damage.
-Ratzon: multiple players marked with green AoEs—spread.
-Ein: faces a random player and blasts a 180-degree cone—stay stacked behind him.
-At 60%, adds spawn: kill Binah first, then Cochma.
st.d:
-Spread fast when marked by Ratzon.
-Keep behind boss to avoid Ein blast.
-Burn Binah add first.
st.h:
-Prepare AoE heals after Fiendish Rage.
-Clean up Ratzon damage—multiple players hit at once.
st.t:
-Keep boss centered so players can stack safely.
-Pick up adds immediately; tank Binah away for focus kill.

st.g:
-Stay toward center—falling is possible now.
-Pillar of Mercy: stand near blue circles (not inside) to avoid knockback off.
-Beam markers: two players get cleaves—split directions.
-Storm of Words must die before Revelation; drops air current for arm sweep—stand inside.
-Spread out before Sephirot’s beam, then restack.
-Red pillar mechanic: one player in each to prevent raidwide damage.

5482.g: Spread for the green AoE markers.

5850.g: Phase 2 combo. Stay centered, handle the knockback circles safely, then split for the two cleave markers.

5851.g: Soak the red pillars. Put one player in each to prevent raid damage.

5852.g: Spread for Sephirot's beam, then restack in the center.

5853.g: Huge 180-degree frontal blast at one player. Stay stacked behind Sephirot.

5855.g: Stack on the marked player to share the hit.

5493.g: Spread out for the beam sequence, then restack in the center.

5496.g: Phase 2 combo mechanic. Stay centered and be ready to separate marked and unmarked players.

5500.g: Two players are marked for huge cleaves. Split marked and unmarked players to opposite sides.

5503.g: Blue knockback circles. Stand next to them on the inside, not inside them.

5509.g: Soak the red pillars. Put one player in each.

5857.g: Arm sweep mechanic. Use the air current when marked by arrows to avoid it.

5858.g: Arm sweep mechanic. Use the air current when marked by arrows to avoid it.

5867.g: Kill the Storm of Words add before Revelation wipes the raid.

280.g:
-Casts Psycho Squamae (frontal cone) and spawns player clones that do Neura Squamae (look-away cone).
-Toxic Squama tethers a cloud to a player that explodes for AoE damage and puddles Vulnerability Up.
280.d:
-Face clone-cast away from boss and raid to avoid Neura Squamae cone.
-Kite Toxic Squama tether until it expires to avoid puddle placement.
280.h:
-Heal players hit by Toxic Squama explosion and shields advised on vulnerable targets.
-Pre-shield before Toxic Squama tether to reduce Vulnerability Up effects.
280.t:
-Tank boss facing away; reposition promptly when clones spawn.
-Maintain cleave rhythm without pulling tethered cloud into group.

281.g: -Casts Ancient Aero/Stone/Holy which spawn orbs that grow and explode unless popped; ancient Libra applies earth/wind resistance debuffs.
281.d:
-Destroy spawned orbs quickly—assign resistant players based on Libra debuff.
-Maintain DPS on boss between orb phases.
281.h:
-Prioritize shields/heals on orb target counters.
-Plan raid healing for Ancient Holy and overlapping debuffs.
281.t:
-Hold boss centrally; face away during cleaves.
-Pick up adds quickly post-sphere and kite them off orb locations.

282.g:
-Three HP phases via Seed of Life (2 → 1 → 0). Effects flip under **Reverse**
-Glory: tank cone
-Understand stance rules:
  Normal: Cure IV = light circle (step in to block heal), Regen = healing field (move boss out)
  Reverse: Cure IV = point-blank AoE, regen = bleed ground—avoid
282.t:
-Face Glory away
-Move Kuribu out of normal Regen zones
-In Reverse, keep her away from party during proximity Cure IV
282.d: -Kill Decoy adds first: Low Putto (Reverse active) or High Putto (no Reverse)
282.h:
-Heavy healing during Reverse Cure IV proximity blasts
-Dispels not possible—sustain through Bleed zones if anyone missteps

286.g:
-Adds spawn in corners → tank pick them up, DPS focus immediately.
-Red/orange marker = drop large puddle away from party.
-Central tower circle spawns red/violet puddles; step in briefly to trigger the puddles.
-When bombs spawn, use RED puddle → turn gorilla → push bombs to far corner.
-When the boss is big and uses Boost, use VIOLET puddle → turn bird → survive Boost groundpounds.
286.t:
-Tank boss in the corner.
-Swap at 4 Concussion stacks: OT provokes to take the tankbuster while MT is stunned and vulnerable.
-Keep boss faced away from party during puddle drops.
-Position so bomb pushes can be directed into a safe corner.
286.h:
-Prepare heals for tank during debuff stacks.
-Watch damage from puddles/bomb mispositions.
-Top party before Boost if bird transform timing is late.

st.g:
-Avoid mines; the tank may need to move Blaster if mines block space.
-When marked for falling copies, spread out in a line to avoid overlapping damage.
-Copies charge in their facing direction after landing; dodge their paths.
st.d: -Spread cleanly for copy drops and dodge the later charges.
st.h: -Watch players clipped by copy drops, mines, or charges.
st.t:
-Move Blaster if mines clutter the arena.
-No tank swap required.

st.g:
-Read Brawler's hands: single drill is a proximity line, single laser is tank soak, double laser is shared damage.
-Stack behind the boss unless handling drill or laser mechanics.
-Lasers bypass tank invulnerability.
st.d:
-Stack behind Brawler for double laser.
-Move out if targeted by the drill line.
st.h:
-Heal the group after double laser.
-Watch the tank during single laser soaks.
st.t:
-Face Brawler away.
-Swap after 3-4 Magic Vulnerability Up stacks.

st.g:
-Go to the elevation opposite your debuff: high/purple debuff to low panels, low/red debuff to raised panels.
-Wrong elevation deals heavy damage and Vulnerability Up.
-Orbs over a target show how many players must stand in the ring.
st.d:
-Move to the correct panel height quickly.
-Fill stack rings with the indicated number of players.
st.h:
-Heal unavoidable AoE damage after elevation checks.
-Recover players who fail height or stack mechanics.
st.t: -Swap only if you gain Vulnerability Up from a failed elevation check.

st.g:
-Blue-marked player places the water sprite.
-Use Shiva ice rings to freeze the water into an ice boulder.
-Hide behind the ice boulder for Ultra Flash.
st.d:
-Place and freeze the water safely.
-Get behind the boulder before Ultra Flash.
st.h: -Prepare healing after knockbacks and failed boulder hides.
st.t:
-Swap after 2 Vulnerability Up stacks.
-Keep boss positioning clear of lava pools.

5620.g: Marked players should spread out; copies will fall and later charge in their facing direction.
5620.d: Spread cleanly and dodge the later charge paths.

5633.g: Brawler is changing weapon hands; read the hands for drill, single laser, or double laser.

5912.g: Double laser; stack with the group to split damage.
5912.t: Join the group; invulnerability will not bypass lethal laser damage.

5913.g: Single drill proximity line; targeted player gets distance and everyone else avoids the line.

5916.g: Height check: high/purple debuff goes low, low/red debuff goes to raised panels.

5919.g: Unavoidable AoE after height mechanics; heal and mitigate.

5659.g: Use ice rings to freeze the water sprite into an ice boulder for Ultra Flash.

5922.g: Hide behind the frozen ice boulder or Ultra Flash wipes the party.

5928.g: Knockback incoming; position so you can reach the ice boulder afterward.

st.g:
-Avoid floor spikes (Bleed + Vuln).
-Purple marker → stay away; Sizzlebeam is a straight line.
-Dodge large floor AoEs that drain MP + apply long Bleed.
-Uplander Doom = multi-hit tankbuster with stacking Phys Vuln.
-When a player is targeted for the grab, **stay away** so you aren’t stunned/grabbed.
-During cages, kill adds quickly.
-When spikes retract, Shanoa starts dropping True Hearts → **kill immediately** or boss heals + gains damage buff.
-Weight of the World ball rolls around; avoid or take 9999 dmg + knockback.
-Bomb (if seen) tethers to a player → drag to corner before explosion.
st.t: -When True Hearts spawn, drag boss away from them.
st.h: -You cannot heal players inside cages—prepare pre-shields if possible.

st.g:
-Cages occur one at a time; you cannot heal the trapped player.
Cages:

-Red cage (Pyretic): **stand still, no actions**.
-Purple (Throttle): kill Alarum fast.
-White (Frostbite): avoid walls; kill Gobwalker.
-Green (Poison vent): stand on vent so party isn’t poisoned.

-Boss casts Perpetual Ray (tankbuster) and Mega Beam (line AoE); periodically summons Steam Regulators that explode if not killed.
-Discoid: dangerous orbs spawn—intercept them or players die instantly.
st.d:
-Burst Regulators quickly to prevent Vulnerability Up/Down on raid.
-Intercept Discoid orbs to save tethered players.
st.h:
-Stack AoE heals for beam overlaps and explosion splash.
-Quickly top off players getting hit by Discoid if intercept fails.
st.t:
-Tank swap after Perpetual Ray to avoid stack buildup.
-Face boss away from raid for Mega Beam and group Discoid pathing.

st.g: -Two bosses appear on opposite sides: Brawler uses tankbusters (single/double), Vortexer uses Ice Missile (aoe pool), Fire Pool, and Super Cyclone.
st.d:
-Stay behind Brawler for shared busters; dodge Vortexer pools promptly.
-Kill the priority boss as assigned, switch when done.
st.h:
-Stack and mitigate double buster AoE; heal through Fire/Ice pool overlap.
-Prioritize heals when Super Cyclone and tank busters coincide.
st.t:
-Each tank holds a boss on assigned side.
-Maintain separation to avoid cleave overlap.

st.g: -Blaster summons clones (Mirage) and Mines; Swindler casts Height and Enumeration mechanics requiring positional response.
st.d:
-Avoid clone lines; dodge mines promptly.
-React to Height debuffs by standing on correct floor; match Enumeration numbers.
st.h:
-Heal through mine splash and misplacement damage.
-Reduce vulnerability from Height/Enumeration overlaps.
st.t:
-Pull and face bosses separately on opposite sides.
-Avoid overlapping mechanics between the two bosses.

st.g:
-Final form combining all previous bosses abilities: tankbuster, line AoEs, stack markers, jumps, beams.
-Enrage begins 10 s after complete cycle.
st.d:
-Dodge all recycled AoEs and stack for Long Needle properly.
-Handle Super Jump and Apocalyptic Ray by positioning.
st.h:
-Use raid cooldowns on Double Rocket Punch and Mega Beam phases.
-Heal through overlapping mechanics after combining all previous mechanics.
st.t: -Swap at Double Rocket Punch; face boss away and position to dodge AoEs and lasers.

298.g:
-Phase 1: tankbuster + Heavy cleave; orange markers place web; burrows then does ring AoEs.
-Phase 2: draws players to web—split tasks: top handles orbs/spiders, bottom destroys Keyknots to drop the web.
-Phase 3: mixes Phases 1 and 2 with additional web/tornado mechanics.
    -Shadow burst: if marked, stack within melee distance.
    -Orange marker: place webs AWAY FROM CENTER.
    -Widow's Kiss: get on a web to not get sucked center and wrecked.
298.d:
-After initial rings, stay stacked for tankbuster then spread during Heavy.
-In Phase 2, DPS on purple orbs first, kill spiders later; bottom DPS handles Keyknots.
298.h:
-Apply shields before Heavy AoEs; coordinate tether breaks.
-Top heal through Implosion and drop phase; bottom heal through orb and spider burst damage.
298.t:
-Tank boss and avoid plowing into party.
-1 tank holds boss top during Phase 2, other picks up spiders after drop.

299.g:
-Phase 1: kill Shriveled Talons before Necropurge finishes.
-Necropurge creates green puddles; avoid them unless you are preparing to survive Megadeath later.
-Punishing Ray spawns towers that each need one player, but wait if Megiddo Flame columns are covering them.
-Brand of the Fallen: stack with players who have the same marker.
-Phase 2 (Void Call): kill Succubus first, then Haagenti, then Dahak.
-Phase 3: gain Gradual Zombification from the green puddles to survive Megadeath.
-When Evil Mist spawns Poison Mists in Phase 3, stand next to them immediately so the puddles appear in time for Megadeath.
-Dark Eruption drops fire puddles on marked players; place them away from everyone.
299.h:
-Esuna Doom.
-Post-Megadeath, heal through Hell Wind and ongoing AoEs.

6078.g: Green puddles appear under players. Avoid them unless you need Gradual Zombification for Megadeath.

6080.g: Multiple column AoEs. Move out, and wait to soak Punishing Ray towers if a column is covering one.

6082.g: Orange markers drop fire puddles. Place them away from the group.

6085.g: Raidwide damage that spawns Poison Mists. Avoid the mists normally, but in Phase 3 stand next to them so they turn into puddles for Megadeath.

6086.g: Adds spawn. Prioritize Succubus, then Hagenti, then Dahak.

6090.g: Instant kill unless you have Gradual Zombification or full Zombification.

6092.g: Group with players who have the same marker to avoid damage and Toad.

300.g:
-Alliance A goes left, B in the middle, C to the right.
-Kill Void Fire quickly or else big boom.
-Kill Parthenope and rejoin middle.
-Step on red circles to create a barrier in the middle against Flaring Epigraph.
300.h: -If Big Burst goes off from Void Fire, expect need to burst heal everyone.
300.t: Let alliance B tank take the miniboss. Go left/right on alliance A/C.

301.g:
-Arena edge is lethal.
-Cycles through Sphere, Pyramid, and Cube forms, then repeats all of them in the last phase.
-Sphere: place the red-black proximity markers apart, kill Singularity Fragments, and handle the stack marker.
-Pyramid: move to the ring sections beside the rectangular platform to avoid the line AoE.
-Cube: stand next to the boss on the rectangular platform to avoid the donut AoE.
-Black Hole starts the Ozmashade phase; kill the platform targets, then kill Ozmashade before Doomsday.
-In Ozmashade, look away from Assimilation and spread the red markers to corners.
301.d:
-Spread the Sphere markers so Debris Burst explosions do not overlap.
-Stop moving and sheathe before Acceleration Bomb expires.
-Burn the Sphere adds and the Ozmashade targets quickly.
301.h:
-Cleanse Poison, Timer, and Bleeding in Pyramid.
-Shield the stack marker and heal tanks soaking Ozmaspheres.
-Free players trapped by Assimilation if they fail the gaze.
301.t:
-Soak Ozmaspheres in Cube form away from the party.
-Keep the laser cleaves off the raid in Cube form.

6144.g: Pulls everyone into the Ozmashade phase.

6147.g: Cube form. Move onto the rectangular platform to avoid the donut AoE.

6149.g: Stay next to the boss to avoid the donut AoE, then tanks separate for lasers and soak Ozmaspheres.

6182.g: Pyramid form. Move to the ring sections to avoid the line AoE.

6183.g: Sphere form. Prepare for meteor spreads, adds, and stack mechanics.

6184.g: Pyramid line AoE. Move to the ring sections; it also applies Poison and Timer if hit.

6190.g: Raidwide damage with a small knockback. Stay close to the boss so you do not get knocked off.

302.g:
-Cycles between Sphere, Pyramid, and Cube forms.
-Sphere: Spread proximity markers left/back to avoid Debris Burst overlap. Kill adds. Handle stack marker.
-Pyramid: Move to ring platform to dodge line AoE.
-Cube: Stand on rectangular platform to avoid donut AoE. Tanks bait lasers and soak Ozmaspheres away from group.
-Ozmashade Phase: stand on circle to kill the add. Look away from Assimilation. Kill Ozmashade before Doomsday.
-Final Phase: Repeats all forms with doubled meteor targets.
302.d:
-Spread correctly for meteors. Handle stack marker.
-Stop all actions before Acceleration Bomb ends.
-Avoid ring AoE and let tanks soak orbs.
-Quickly burn adds and spread proximity markers in Ozmashade.
302.h:
-Shield meteor and stack damage.
-Cleanse Bleed/Poison in Pyramid. Time heals around Acceleration Bomb.
-Heal tanks during orb soaks and Holy.
-Free trapped players during Ozmashade and heal proximity hits.
302.t:
-Face boss away. In Cube, absorb Ozmaspheres and avoid cleaving raid with lasers.
-Tank adds in Sphere. In Ozmashade, help burn adds and reposition fast post-return.

303.g:
-Haircut cleaves the left or right side based on which side of her hair becomes a blade; getting hit applies Flesh Wound.
-Extension telegraphs still pull you in if you stand near them.
-If the Entanglement tentacles from Extension are not killed in time, trapped players die to Garrote.
-Bijous and Grand Bijous power up Dancing Mad with Energize, so kill the smaller Bijous first.
-Living Locks: stay near the axe flowers to avoid their donut AoEs and away from the bulb flowers that knock players up.
-Penetration pulls you in if you face the boss and pushes you out if you look away; aim to get pushed into the empty spaces.
-Depth Charge is followed by Haircut; watch the blade side after the dash.
-Blade flowers later fire beams across the center from the arena sides.
303.d:
-Avoid blade side during Haircut and watch for tether pulls.
-Burn Bijous fast; kite chasing AoEs along edges.
-Stay in safe zones near axes during flower phase.
303.h:
-Cleanse Flesh Wound from Haircut.
-Heal through Dancing Mad and Evil Tress knockups.
-Watch Garrote and assist freeing trapped players.
303.t:
-Face the boss away so Bloodied Nail does not cleave the raid.
-Keep her near the middle to leave room for Haircut and Depth Charge.
-Turn the boss to direct Haircut away from the raid when possible.

6154.g: Boss changes hair pattern. Re-read which side Haircut and Split End will cover.

6155.g: Haircut cleave. Dodge the blade side.
