6156.g: Split End cleaves the blade side. Move to the safe side.

6158.g: Boss changes hair pattern. Re-read which side Haircut and Split End will cover.

6159.g: Haircut cleave. Dodge the blade side.

6160.g: Split End cleaves the blade side. Move to the safe side.

6162.g: Tethers pull players in. Kill the tentacles or tethered players die to Garrote.

6168.g: Raidwide damage. Kill Bijous first to weaken it.

6174.g: Lethal tether resolution if Extension is not handled.

6175.t: Mitigate and face away from the raid.

6176.g: Charge attack followed by Haircut. Dodge the blade side after the dash.

6177.g: Push or pull based on whether you face the boss. Avoid getting forced into the flowers.

st.g:
-Waves of pirates interspersed with cannon fire and tethered Coeurl adds.
-Dodge line AoEs and kill the Coeurl quickly to avoid healer bleed debuffs.
st.d:
-Maintain movement to dodge line attacks and cannon circles.
-Priority-target tethered Coeurl to remove bleed/healer debuff.
st.h:
-Raid takes incidental damage from AoEs—heal steadily.
-Quick single-target heals when Coeurl applies bleed fixate.
st.t:
-Face mobs to direct AoEs safely.
-Grip and tank Coeurl adds quickly to protect party.

st.g:
-Alternates between lightning tethers, freezing markers, and slime pools.
-Use lightning mechanics wisely: break tethers or soak lightning in slime, group freezing circles close for safety.
st.d:
-When tethered by lightning, separate to drop tether.
-When targeted for lightning, move into slime to become fettered and avoid damage.
st.h:
-Prepare burst AoE heals during freezing explosions.
-Monitor players in slime pools and mana-costly heals from tether failings.
st.t:
-Keep boss positioned away from mechanics.
-Call out tether and freezing so tanks can reposition adds/platform.

st.g: -Two phases: first melee with cone/tankbuster AoEs; second includes chests with antidotes, heavy marked target AoEs, and keg bombs.
st.d:
-Phase 1: dodge melee cleaves.
Phase 2: kill chest mobs for antidote, dodge keg explosives, and burst boss post-AoE.
st.h:
-Make sure each player gets to a chest with a potion to remove the poison.
-Heal marked players and prep cooldowns during keg explosions and tank busters.
st.t:
-Phase 1: face boss away from party.
Phase 2: tank boss to allow chest access, then reposition to avoid keg blasts and heavy-marked attacks.

st.g:
-Avoid Hot Wings (safe line along body) and Hot Tail (safe where Wings hit).
-Deafening Bellow raidwide, later double-cast.
-Spread from ground holes; avoid fire trail.
-Stack center when boss flies away, then spread for AoEs.
st.d:
-Stay mid-range so you can reposition quickly for holes and trail.
-Spread cleanly after holes spawn to avoid overlap.
st.h:
-Prepare heals for repeated Deafening Bellows.
-Position to heal spread-out players during holes + trail.
st.t:
-Face boss away from group.
-Anchor near center to allow group safe positioning.

st.g:
-Kill adds fast; failure wipes raid.
-Middle add untankable; avoid its frontal swipes.
-Side adds cleave—tanks face outwards.
-DPS check may require LB and healer DPS.
st.d:
-Focus side adds first; burn middle last.
-Use LB if DPS is low to beat timer.
st.h:
-Assign one healer per tank for side adds.
-Contribute DPS if healing load is light.
st.t:
-Tank each side add facing outward.
-Swap cooldowns as needed to handle cleaves.

st.g:
-Akh Morn tankbuster—heavier single-hit.
-Geirskogul: avoid targeted line AoE.
-Meteors: spread to edges, leave circles quickly.
-Room AoE after meteors—move away and heal heavy damage.
st.d:
-Spread meteors evenly to edges.
-Move quickly out of ground circles to avoid bleed.
st.h:
-Shield/heal Akh Morn target.
-Be ready for burst AoE after meteor mechanic.
st.t:
-Mitigate Akh Morn heavily.
-Face boss so Geirskogul line doesn’t clip party.

st.g:
-Akh Morn now requires full raid stack; bolts increase each cast.
-3 Fireballs spawn—safe in unused row/column, then sprint center for Hot Wings.
-Hot Wings safe line, followed by Hot Tail covering opposite line.
-Ground holes + fire trail repeat from Phase 1.
st.d:
-Stack on Akh Morn target until bolts end.
-Reposition fast between bomb, Wings, and Tail mechanics.
st.h:
-Prepare big raidwide heals for Akh Morn stacks.
-Layer shields and mitigation before Hot Wings + Hot Tail combos.
st.t:
-Stay stacked during Akh Morn even as MT.
-Reface boss away after bolts; keep control near center.

st.g:
-Thunder II is a large frontal cone, then Thunder III is a donut with a safe spot near Sophia.
-Aero knockback is minor early, but later the rails are gone, so respect it.
-Daughter fires Light Dew line AoEs from the arena edge, and Sophia Rush is another full line from east or west.
-Move away from player-targeted proximity markers.
st.h: -Prepare healing after repeated AoEs and any failed proximity markers.
st.t: -Face Sophia away so Thunder II stays clear of the party.

st.g:
-Cloudy Heavens makes Sophia invulnerable and applies Eternal Doom until the three adds die.
-Kill order is healer, then lancer, then paladin.
-The paladin add has a directional parry, the healer add uses a gaze, and the lancer add leaves a persistent ice puddle, so place it at the edge.
st.h: -If players die with Eternal Doom, they become zombies and attack the party.
st.t: -Separate and hold the adds cleanly, especially the lancer at the side.

st.g:
-From here on, players can fall off the platform.
-Quasar tilts the arena toward the heavier side. Orange meteors weigh 1, blue meteors weigh 3, so usually move opposite the blue side and stand at the edge before the tilt.
-Avoid sliding through the lingering ice puddle from the adds phase.
-Sin & Punishment gives light and dark rings; pair with a player of the opposite color.
-At low HP, another healer add spawns. Either kill it or have the off-tank drag it away while the raid finishes Sophia.
st.h: -Prepare for fall deaths and Quasar mistakes after the rails are gone.
st.t: -Be ready to pick up the late healer add if the group stays on Sophia.

6510.g: Quasar tilts the arena. Move to the lighter side before the slide. (weights: blue=3, orange=1)

6514.g: Donut AoE. Move in near Sophia.

6515.g: Knockback from Sophia. Do not get pushed off.

6516.g: Frontal cone. Stay out of front.
6516.t: Face it away from the party.

6528.g: Adds phase begins. Sophia is invulnerable until the Demiurges die.

6533.g: Line charge across the arena. Move out of the path.

6524.g: Drops a persistent ice puddle. Keep it at the edge.

6525.g: Directional parry. Do not attack into the defended side.

st.g: -Avoid standing between narrow AoE lines—these indicate where a large follow-up AoE will strike
st.t: -Tank sideways so the party can see AoE markers clearly
st.h:
-Prepare light AoE healing during sequence attacks
-Heal players hit by overlapping AoEs

st.g:
-Casts Bibliocide (raid-wide), Sea of Flames puddles, and Slosh (run away from boss).
-Ferrofluid: Players get + and - marks, if your mark is the same as the boss's, run close to the boss. Otherwise, run away.
-Seal of Night and Day: Players get sun and moon marks; run to the corresponding sun or moon sigil on the floor.
st.d:
-Respond correctly to symbol mechanics (stack/spread).
-When tethered by Slosh, move away from party to reduce splash damage.
st.h:
-Shield and heal through Bibliocide and Sea of Flames.
-Top off Slosh target and be prepared for overlap during symbol phase.
st.t:
-Face boss away from puddles.
-Allow tethered DPS to move freely and avoid cleaving group during Slosh.

312.g:
-White circle deals with Quakes.
-Black circle deals with Tornados.
-Green circle toggles Imp status. Use to turn back after getting hit by Properties of Imps.
-Find a rock to hide behind when Behemoth casts Ecliptic Meteor.

326.g:
-Single-target tankbuster cleaves that can be shared between tanks.
-Minor raid AoE from Panzerschreck but no major mechanics.
326.d:
-Stay stacked behind boss to maximize uptime and cleave efficiency.
-Help stun adds when they spawn to support clear speed.
326.h:
-Heal consistently through raid-wide Panzerschreck.
-Be prepared for incidental damage between pulls.
326.t:
-Stack both tanks for the tankbuster and face boss away.
-Manage enmity cleanly; no swaps needed until taunt cooldown.

327.g:
-Arena split into 4 quadrants with intermittent lava.
-Adds must be dragged into lit platforms before lava's in' to melt, otherwise boss absorbs them and gains powers.
-Full-metal Faust same mechanic but has extra HP.
-Boss uses Scrap (tankbuster), Scrapline cleaves, Scrap Burst (hide behind meteor), and Scrap Bomb stack markers.
327.d: -When off-tank pulls adds, focus them as they must die ASAP.
327.h: -Keep eye on off-tank when they pull adds.
327.t:
-Main tank holds boss facing away.-
Off-tank: grab power generators and put on robot piles to wake them up.
-Pull activated robots to the lit panel - lava will sweep in and melt the defeated robot.
-Adds explode if alive when lava's in, wiping the raid.
-Full metal faust has a lot of HP, drag to the party and into a lit panel only as it gets close to dying.

st.g: -Arena features spike traps, ball traps, and lightning floors. Boss jumps between buttons to trigger them and brings in a steamroller add during phase 2.
st.d:
-Stand clear of spikes and trap zones; stack behind boss between mechanics.
-Burst steamroller quickly or it clears the raid.
st.h:
-Heal party through trap damage and immobilizations.
-Prepare for line and raid AoEs from adds.
st.t:
-Hold boss centrally to guide trap usage.
-Lead steamroller clear to delay its path toward the raid.

st.g: -Boss begins using a mix of unmarked AoEs: green donut or red cleave (Single Charge), plus saw blades and ongoing trap mechanics.
st.d: -Green = stand mid-range; Red = move away fast. Stay out of saw paths.
st.h:
-Position to avoid red cleaves and wall saw damage.
-Heal through burst AoEs after mechanics.
st.t:
-Anticipate AoE cues to face boss away from party.
-Guide raid into safe spots between traps and saws.

st.g:
-Kill the flying E.D.D. add before it self-destructs
-Optical Sight has three variants:
  1) Four players marked with green circles—spread to avoid overlap
  2) Large central light circle—move to edge to avoid Vulnerability Up
  3) Sequential small circles—wait in middle, then move to cleared outer section
-Photon drops four players to low HP—healers top off quickly
-Propeller Wind causes Confusion unless you hide behind objects; Esuna cleanses it if needed
-GA-100 hits OT heavily and deals reduced AoE damage by distance—spread slightly
-At 50%, boss transforms—click a duct and complete the timed sequence or party wipe
st.t:
-OT Grab and hold E.D.D. immediately on spawn
-Mitigate GA-100 and be ready for the post-shield rush

st.g:
-Limit Cut phase: if damage before transition was low, four Lapis Lazuli Orbs spawn—kill them before Eternal Darkness
-Eternal Darkness is raidwide AoE followed by room-wide Bleed; surviving orbs cause a wipe
-Optical Sight gains flying adds firing lethal line AoEs—watch for overlaps
-Plasma Shield phase: stand in front of the shield to damage it until destroyed; Cruise Chaser rushes MT afterward
-Prey marks a player for triple AoE—healers pre-shield and sustain through damage

-Divine Spear is a frontal cleave—face boss away.
-Punishing Heat is a tankbuster.
-Mega Holy is raidwide AoE.
-Sacrament fires cross-shaped line AoEs; safe spots are diagonals.
-Blazing Scourge marks 2 players with heavy AoE—spread away.
st.d:
-Stay at diagonals during Sacrament.
-Spread quickly if marked by Blazing Scourge.
st.h:
-AoE healing needed for Mega Holy.
-Spot heal Blazing Scourge victims—damage is heavy.
st.t:
-Keep boss faced away for Divine Spear.
-Mitigation for Punishing Heat; reposition to ease Sacrament dodges.

st.g:
-Wave 1: 2 packs of 3 adds—stack mid and cleave.
-Wave 2: 2 Generals—tanks split them and face away.
-Wave 3: 4 Wings spam Almost Holy—focus kill to reduce raid damage.
-Judgement follows waves—use tank LB or wipe.
st.d:
-Burn adds fast, focus Wings to cut raid damage.
-DO NOT USE LB, TANK NEEDS TO USE IT FOR JUDGEMENT.
st.h:
-Raid healing needed during Wings’ Almost Holy spam.
-Prepare for raidwide hit after tank LB during Judgement.
st.t:
-Pick up all adds quickly, face Generals away.
-A tank should use LB during Judgement - wait for the final 5 seconds countdown.

st.g:
-Temporal Stasis freezes players; mechanics resolve after debuff falls.
-Plaint of Solidarity = stack, Plaint of Severity (green marker) = spread.
-Sacrament follows stasis—dodge quickly after freeze ends.
-Time Gate: 4 adds spawn and enter portals—1 player must chase and kill each.
-Gravitational Anomaly spawns overlapping circles with triangle/edge safe zones.
-Incinerating Heat = stack.
-Summon Alexander introduces Communion: players drop puddles from laser beams, move them to edge.
st.d:
-During Stasis, memorize mechanics (stack or spread) and move instantly once free.
-If chosen for Communion, drop puddles on arena edge.
-Burn portal adds quickly—help teammates once yours is dead.
st.h:
-Top group before Stasis; healing window is tight after freeze.
-Raidwide healing for Mega Holy, Incinerating Heat, and post-Wings damage.
-Heal Communion DoT victims as they place puddles.
st.t:
-Face boss carefully before Stasis to control Sacrament angle.
-Assign tank LB for Judgement if still alive from previous phase.
-Pick up portal adds immediately if chosen.

st.g: -Sharpstrike cleaves tank; puddle stun (Mucal Glob) precedes lethal Shuck—interrupt by killing a leg. Kamikiri adds spawn individual AoE puddles—kill to avoid Dropsy.
st.d:
-Focus Kamikiri first, then boss leg to interrupt Shuck quickly.
-Avoid standing near others to limit Dropsy puddle overlap.
st.h:
-Shield or heal tank before Sharpstrike. Prep burst if Shuck cast begins fail leg interrupt.
-Top off players in Dropsy puddles quickly.
st.t: -Face boss away during Sharpstrike. Grab adds early and position leg hits for cleanness.

st.g: -Boss casts Seduce → Coriolis Kick; players must touch one of four boxes to avoid Seduce by gaining Old status. Uses Tornadogenesis and Abyssal Volcano puddles chasing players.
st.d: -Use assigned box to dodge Seduce. Stack outside of puddles and keep moving during volcano marks.
st.h: -Heal through Tornadogenesis hits. Shield and prep raid for Abyssal Volcano splash damage.
st.t: -Face boss away from center to avoid cleaves crossing tanks. Maintain movement patterns to avoid puddle knockback overlap.

st.g: -Hides under Thick Fog triggering Churn adds that apply Dropsy—kill all quickly. Boss then bursts out with Black Tide causing zone damage + Vulnerability Up. Sharks spawn (Bite and Run), boss may fear via Mad Stare.
st.d: -Burn Churn adds rapidly to prevent stacking Dropsy. Steer clear of rippling zones after boss reappears.
st.h:
-Sustain raid during Thick Fog add waves. Heal through Black Tide and cleanse or manage Vulnerability Up.
-Face away quickly on Mad Stare to avoid fear.
st.t: -Pull and isolate sharks away from raid. Face Yohi away consistently and reposition after fog adds clear.

-Kill Deathgates during the Lifegate intermission.
st.h:

-Wake or recover players hit by Nightmare.

-Keep Diabolos faced away for Shadethrust.

-Flare Star drops circle AoEs on random players.

-Face Zurvan away to contain Metal Cutter cleave
-Anchor boss near safe tiles to reduce party movement

-Rasen Kaikyo: circle AoEs under all players—spread.
-Yata No Kagami: marked player gets knocked back, determines safe zone for platform AoE.
-Brightstorm: stack on marked player after Yata.
-Dark Clouds spawn and fire line AoEs that inflict Paralysis.

-Spread for Rasen Kaikyo, then regroup.
-Stack quickly for Brightstorm after knockback.
-Stay aware of Dark Cloud line AoEs.
st.h:
-Prepare heals for Brightstorm stack.
-Cleanse Paralysis if possible from Dark Cloud hits.
st.t:
-Hold Susano steady, face away.
-Watch for untelegraphed Assail tankbuster.

st.g:
-One tank must pick up the crystal and clash with Susano.
-Focus Ame-no-Murakumo sword before cast completes or party wipes.
-Off-tank intercepts orbs from Sheer Force to protect party.
-Ends with a red line AoE—anyone inside dies.
st.d:
-Burn the sword as priority during clash.
-Stay away from red line marker.
st.h:
-Heal clash tank under Flesh Wound DoT.
-Be ready for incidental splash damage from missed orbs.
st.t:
-MT takes crystal and holds clash.
-OT collects Sheer Force orbs to reduce raid damage.

st.g:
-Stormsplitter: line tankbuster.
-Ama-no-iwato: one player trapped in stone; identify bottom-most target in enemy list and free before Sealed Gate finishes.
-Phase 1 mechanics return with increased overlap.
-Ukehi: raidwide, can occur once or twice.
st.d:
-Switch to trapped stone quickly during Ama-no-iwato.
-Spread/stack properly as Phase 1 repeats.
st.h:
-Prepare strong heals for Stormsplitter.
-Top party for double Ukehi casts.
st.t:
-Mitigate Stormsplitter.
-Assist in freeing the correct stone during Ama-no-iwato.

st.g:
-Arena edge is lethal.
-Tidal Wave: run to the waterspout edge so the knockback carries you across instead of off the platform.
-Hellfire: stand in water puddles to reduce damage.
-Judgment Bolt: stay out of puddles.
-Right wing glow marks players to spread for lightning; left wing glow means dodge the ice attack.
-Earth Breath targets two players with cones; place them to leave a safe side or center.
-Akh Morn is a stack mechanic.
-After two Corrupted Aether attacks, the fight transitions.
st.h:
-Shield before Tidal Wave, Hellfire, and Judgment Bolt.
-Top the party after Earth Breath and Akh Morn.
st.t: -Mitigate Ahk Morn hits and keep Earth Breath safe.

st.g:
-Shinryu leaves the platform and large AoEs appear; move far from each blast.
-Cocoons land as proximity AoEs, then spawn three waves of Hakkinryu and Ginryu adds.
-Kill all adds quickly; Hakkinryu uses Death Sentence on the tanks.
-Everyone is Fettered for the Active Time Maneuver before the next phase, so mash the button to fill the bar.
st.d: -Avoid spawn zones and focus down adds fast.
st.h: -Heal the proximity hits and prepare for the transition after the add waves.
st.t: -Pick up Hakkinryu quickly and mitigate Death Sentence.

-Earthen Fury breaks a marked platform.
-Tidal Wave, Hellfire, Judgment Bolt, Diamond Dust, and Aerial Blast all return.
-Diamond Dust makes the floor slippery; stop moving.
-Aerial Blast pulses knockbacks from the center, so stay close to the middle.
-Ground Pound targets the center platform with a large AoE.
-Burning Chains tethers two players; run apart to break them.
-Ahk Morn returns, and a second blue beam later pulses on a random player.
-Every two Corrupted Aether attacks, Shinryu uses Line Charge again and swaps sides.
406.h:
-Shield before Judgment Bolt, Aerial Blast, and Ahk Morn.
-Watch players soaking Line Charge or breaking chains near broken tiles.
406.t:
-Help burn the tail when it becomes targetable.
-Keep safe positioning near intact tiles for Line Charge and Ahk Morn.

8101.g: Stack to split the Ahk Morn hits, then move out of the extra blue beam if it spawns on you.

390.g:

-Breath Wing and Clamp are knockbacks; hug the boss for Breath Wing.

390.d:
-If tethered for Twin Bolt, only stand closest if you are the intended soak.

-Mitigate Wyrm Tail and Twin Bolt.

7896.g: Center tornado. Stay out of it.

9175.h: Be ready for two heavy hits.

9183.g: Thin Ice. Minimize movement or you will slide.

9186.g: Knockback. Avoid being pushed into hazards.

391.g:
-Tilted platforms drop into void; watch quake markers and stay on stable tiles.
-Earthquake inflicts Hysteria if on unstable platforms—hug safe corners.

-Off-tank: help locate quake marker and preposition party accordingly.

st.g:
-Ribbit: frontal untelegraphed cone; get behind her
-Spellblade Thunder III: line AoE that inflicts paralysis
-Spellblade Holy: spread/stack markers; unmarked players stack
-Spellblade Blizzard III + Fire III: go out for Blizzard PBAoE, then in/out for Fire donut
-Dark Token: Soul Reapers do point-blank; middle/edges safe. Waltz drops conals at players—don’t overlap
-Playing Field: stand on your role tile

-Blue tiles = safe during Waltz; all others get Earthly Dance knock-up
-Mindjack: Forced March will force you to walk in direction of your arrow debuff. Aim to walk along blue tiles
-Dark Token (6 adds): two safe lanes; spread within them for Holy Edge
st.t: -OT grabs Great Dragon and faces away from the group - it cleaves and fires cones.
st.h: -Prepare to rescue/heal people not on blue tiles.

st.g:
-Rarely experienced as boss dies quickly now. With that said:
-Playing Field + Ribbit: frog-ed players must avoid role tiles
-Mindjack + Spellblade Holy: all march same direction; stay stacked
-Dark Token: Soul Reapers line AoEs across rows/columns—single safe tile line
-Playing Field (frog tiles): intentionally take Ribbit to become frog
-Dimensional Wave: raidwide
-Waltz + Holy: conals + spread/stack

-Doom goes out on two players at the start.
-If Exdeath turns and tethers to the large void orb, Blizzard, Thunder, and Fire use their void versions.
-Blizzard: dodge the player AoEs; for Void Blizzard, start moving around 75% cast and keep moving until you take damage.

-Vacuum Wave is a heavy knockback.
-Holy usually follows Vacuum Wave; stack behind the boss to share damage.

st.h:
-Esuna Doom quickly.
-Prepare for shared damage from Holy and heavy damage from Void Thunder.

st.g:

-A giant head appears after impact: avoid the center under it, then get behind it to avoid the conal hit and Zombification.

-At 33%, vines ring the arena with one gap; use the gap for the safe spot before the meteor lands.
st.d: -Spread away from the party and each other for Flare.
st.h:
-Be ready for repeated raidwide damage during The Decisive Battle sequence.
-Watch players clipped by the head or forced close by the vine pattern.

-Hell of Waste: AoE marker; drop away

-Heavenly Strike: heavy tankbuster—mitigate.
-State of Shock: player grabbed and slammed; others stack at marker twice; AoEs back-to-back.
-Sweep of the Leg: 270° cleave right after shock—safe only behind boss.

-Touching outer ring kills instantly.

-Hundredfold Havoc fires twin sets of arrow-guided circle AoEs—dodge second wave mid-pattern.
-Bombogenesis: orange markers drop—spread markers apart.
-Distant Clap: wide donut AoE with safe space under boss.
-Fight loops previous mechanics until death or enrage.

-Wait for first Havoc wave then move into safe space.
-Spread for Bombogenesis; avoid overlapping markers.
st.h:
-Shield before Havoc; mitigate Bomb overlaps.
-Raid heal before Distant Clap and after loops.
st.t:
-Face boss away and reposition behind him during Havoc.
-Stay under him safely through Distant Clap.

-After the first cycle, Chadarnook starts possessing two paintings at once. Do fire or water first, then take mount-based effects like earth or wind.
-Prey chases two players with repeated circles; keep moving. Demonic Pain tethers want distance, and Flash Gale is the stack marker.

-The Goddess auto-attacks the off-tank throughout the fight.

-Summons Leyak adds dead dragons awaken if broodlings triggered.
st.d:
-Tethered player runs to pillar to transfer tether and avoid stun.
-Prioritize Leyak adds to prevent Heavy debuffs on party.
st.h:
-Pre-shield tank before Predation transfer.
-Heal through incidental damage from Leyak Reflux.
st.t:
-Face boss away and keep donut centered.
-Keep adds off to side and taunt-swap as needed.

st.g:
-Casts Inflammable Fumes (fume rings) then Ashen Ouroboros (edge donut) or Proximity Pyre (close circle).
-Uses Crippling Blow (tankbuster), Deafening Bellow, and Body Slam knockback.
st.d:
-Avoid fume rings before boss's main AoE; dodge accordingly.
-Maintain consistent DPS between mechanics.
st.h:
-Heal through Deafening Bellow and Body Slam knockbacks.
-Pre-shield across overlapping explosions from fume + AoE.
st.t:
-Tank away from unsafe rings and face ark away from group.
-Interrupt Crippling Blow with cooldowns or swaps.

st.g:
-Uses Hot Tail and Hot Wings (line AoEs), Cauterize (fiery line), with eyeball circles spawning randomly.
-The Sable Price: traps a random player that must be freed
-At ~30%, enters add phase: slays adds to stall Rancor gauge before Massacre, followed by Horrid Blaze.
st.d:
-Move out of tail/wing lines and eyeball markers.
-During add phase, burn fast to delay wipe gauge.
st.h:
-Top off players hit by Cauterize and stack heal after Massacre.
-Prepare AoE burst after gauge stops.

248.g:
-Kill initial adds (very low HP) before pushing Adelphel.
-Avoid orbs left on the ground after his charge paths.
-Spread out enough that Shield Bash jumps don’t chain-stun multiple players.

250.g:
-Bait both Hyperdimensional Slashes to the same wall to cluster the Aetherial Tears.
-After two Tears, prepare for Faith Unmoving knockback; don’t get pushed into Tears.
-Avoid Dimensional Rift circles and assorted floor AoEs.

251.g:
-Break Holy Chain by running opposite directions.
-Avoid flame rings from Heavensflame.
-Dodge marching knight lines (apply Slow if hit).
-When Holy Flames spawn at 50%, kill them fast or incoming raidwide hits harder.

st.g:
-Kill moogles in waves; each has a simple, avoidable telegraph.
-Spread for Mograin of Death.
-Dodge line AoEs (Moogleday Night Fever, cone slashes, Pom Holy).
-For Pom Meteor, stand in the 4 red circles to intercept falling heads.
-After last two moogles die, all revive briefly then summon the King.

-King is only target; untargetable moogles repeat earlier mechanics.
-Handle stack markers, spreads, and rotating safe-spots for Moogle-Go-Round.
-Intercept all Pom Meteors (again) during Third Decree.
-Avoid Mog Comet chasing circles.
-Fight loops until King dies.
st.t: -Stack with the other tank when you see the two red balls stack marker.

st.g:
-Arena edge is lethal, but players can be raised after a delay if they fall.
-Inferno is raidwide damage.
-Ordeal of Purgation roots players when Penance expires, so solve the fuse path early and stand in the safe slice before the AoEs fire.
-On rotated Purgation, standing near the originally targeted panel is safe because the fireball shifts to an adjacent panel.
-Shattering Heat is a tankbuster.
-Arch Inferno fills the center and outer ring with rotating AoEs while Conflagration and Radial Flagration cover most of the arena.
-Dodge the rotating fire while reading the line and cone telegraphs.
st.h:
-Prepare for repeated raidwide damage from Inferno and later mechanics.
-Watch tanks during Shattering Heat.
st.t: -Mitigate Shattering Heat.

st.g:
-Kill the adds before Rubicante's Power reaches 100.
-Greater Flamesent repeatedly uses Ghastly Torch raidwides and Burns, so killing it first is safer if healing is strained.
-Dodge Ghastly Flame ground AoEs and Ghastly Wind cones.
-Blazing Rapture hits after the adds phase and applies another Burns DoT.
st.h:
-Expect constant raid damage and Burns stacks during the adds phase.
-Top the party before Blazing Rapture.
st.t: -Shattering Heat can target either tank during the adds phase.

st.g:
-Inferno now puts spread markers on every player and applies Bleeding.
-Flamerake shows a line through the boss, then cascades outward; dodge into the previously unsafe area after the first hit.
-Soulscald marks every player with line AoEs, then repeats as longer blue lines from the same spots.
-Dualfire is a tankbuster cleave on both tanks.
-Sweeping Immolation combines a half-room cleave with player spreads.
-The boss later returns to Phase 1 mechanics, then back to Phase 2.
st.h:
-Inferno in this phase applies Bleeding to everyone.
-Be ready for heavy damage after Soulscald and Dualfire.
st.t: -Separate for Dualfire so each cleave misses the party.

816.g:

-Albion's Embrace is the tankbuster.
-Left Slam and Right Slam are half-room cleaves with brief indicators.
-Knock on Ice spawns three ice chunks, then Icebreaker destroys one with a large AoE.
-Icy Throes marks everyone with spreads and adds two more ice chunks.
-Hide behind a surviving ice chunk to avoid Roar of Albion.
816.h: -Prepare for damage from failed herd charges and Roar mistakes.

31358.g: Three ice chunks appear. Plan which one will remain for the line-of-sight.

31361.g: Large AoE on the targeted ice chunk. Stay clear so one chunk survives.

-Tenebrism spawns four meteor towers that must be soaked one by one, then Glassy-eyed resolves, so look away from other players.
-Later Scarecrow Chase uses four portals around the room instead of two.
817.h:
-Esuna Doom from failed Scarecrow Chase hits.
-Prepare raid healing after Soul Nebula and any missed tower soaks.

31377.g: Point-blank AoE, then a fast donut follow-up.

31382.g: Soak the meteor towers, then look away from other players.

-The arena edge inflicts Dropsy.
-Stygian Deluge is the raidwide.
-Antediluvian grows bubble AoEs, then Body Slam knocks everyone from the middle; the knockback cannot be prevented.
-Hydraulic Ram resolves the telegraphed line charges and circles in the order shown.
-Hydrofall is the stack marker.

-Prepare healing for Stygian Deluge, Tsunami, and mistakes during Cursed Tide.
-Watch players knocked into the edge during Antediluvian.
824.t: -Mitigate Void Torrent and place Hydrofall cleanly.

31110.g: Portal cones track tethered players. Keep the cones away from others.

31112.g: Multiple boss cone AoEs. Move between the cleaves.

31119.g: Bubble AoEs expand, then Body Slam knockback follows. Plan where the push will send you.

31121.g: Knockback from the middle. It cannot be prevented.

31130.g: Adds phase. Three players get point-blank AoEs, one gets the stack marker, and the Flotsam must die first.

32694.g: Memorize the telegraphs. Hydraulic Ram resolves them in order.

st.g:
-Casts alternating line AoEs that inflict Slow and Heavy; follows with Dark Blizzard III and Repel knockback.
-Opens and closes with Disclosure—standing on wrong side causes instant death.
-Words of Winter freezes floor, causing sliding and complicating movement.

-Becomes invulnerable at intervals; adds spawn in books—kill them fast.
-Adds tether orbs to players; drag orb into Byblos to break invulnerability.
-Oil clouds spawn later, deal damage + knockback; don’t run through unnecessarily.
-Gale Cut = frontal cleave, Tail Swipe = rear cleave, Head Down = charge that splits damage along line.

-Marks players with orb drop markers—these spawn vulnerability-up circles if not dropped safely.
-Casts Void Call at ~85/55/25%: lights appear on plates; players must stand in groups to cancel summons or face adds spawning.
-Uses Deep Darkness (outer AoE) followed by Magic Burst (center AoE).

231.g:
-Move away from stunned players; an untelegraphed AoE follows.
-Dodge turret lasers (line) and grenados (circle).
-Kill turrets ASAP to stop wall-dashes and reduce roomwide damage.
-Dodge Magitek Slug lines; avoid the 270° Magitek Spread.

232.g:
-Sphinx: dodge Riddle; avoid front for Chthonic Hush (Poison).
-Anti-Cobra: tankbuster.
-Anti-Naga: look away for Petrifaction; spread for Circle of Flames.
-Anti-Machina: number of rotating spheres indicates how many players should stack for Ballistic Missile; all should stack for Gaseous Bomb.

234.g:
-Both bosses are targetable at all times and must be brought to 0.1% HP.
-Fire orbs: explode, safe spot is far from them.
-Ice orbs: donut, safe spot is IN the orb.
-Esoteric Fusion: collides orbs.
    - If colliding fire, RUN AWAY
    - If colliding ice, run TO them.

-Continues mechanics from previous fight with increased intensity.
-Dualstar: collides 3 sets of two orbs, fire pair - ice pair - fire pair - same mechanic as before.
-Dualstore order is according to the orbs' tether distance - closer = first.

277.g: -Uses Water Bombs (targeted circle AoEs), Odious Croak (persistent frontal cone), Toy Hammer (stun + cone cleave). Summons Poroggo Choirtoads and inflicts Frog Song debuffs on two players.
277.h:
-Shield or cleanse stun from Toy Hammer as soon as possible.
-Heal froged players and raid through bomb and cone damage.

-Kill adds fast; Moglin then tries to revive them.
-Knock corpses out of purple circles to prevent resurrection.
-Focus Captain Mogsun first whenever he’s alive.
-Heal through Holy.

-During Jump, run opposite the proximity marker.
-Charge: unavoidable knockback - stand by a wall.
-Stand behind boss for Quasar to avoid hitting walls.
-Cloud Call spawns a pulsing cloud—drop it at an already-destroyed wall or far edge.

294.g:

-Hallowed Dive: center unsafe → then edges unsafe → return center.
-Akh Morn: full stack.
-Diamond Storm freezes floor—slide only to dodge red AoEs.
-Frigid Dive repeats mid-line AoE during ice.
-Holy Breath: spread.

st.g:
-Wind Blast is a path AoE—dodge quickly.
-Lift summons adds and turrets.
-Turrets cast Hot Air, launching the party upward; stand under Nuzal to bring him down after.
-Airstones tether to boss or turret—kill these first if present.
-Air Raid and Long Burst are unavoidable partywides.

-Prioritize Airstones when they spawn; otherwise kill turrets fast.
-Stand beneath Nuzal during Hot Air cast to end phase safely.
st.h:
-Prepare party healing for Air Raid, Long Burst, and Hot Air overlap.
-Heal add-targeted players quickly—damage spikes are frequent.
st.t:
-Pick up adds as they spawn.
-Position boss so turrets and adds are easy to reach.

st.g:
-On Low is a frontal cleave on tank.
-On High is a partywide AoE with knockback; stand against barriers.
-Dark Wings marks random players with AoEs—spread out.
-Stormcoming spawns windy AoE zones on barriers.
-Swiftfeather causes instant On Low after dash—treat as tankbuster.

-Spread out for Dark Wings.
-Keep near barriers to avoid knockback deaths during On High.
st.h:
-Anticipate heavy party damage from On High; AoE heal after.
-Spot heal Dark Wings targets.
st.t:
-Face boss away from group for On Low.
-Mitigation for Swiftfeather + instant cleave.

st.g:
-Ixali Aero III is a partywide AoE.
-Ixali Aero II is a path AoE—step aside.
-Hawk alternates between stack marker or spread marker—adjust accordingly.
-Summon Garuda: roomwide AoE with small safe zones; all players marked with green crystal AoEs—spread out.
st.d:
-Move quickly into safe zones during Garuda summon.
-Stack or spread as indicated by Hawk marker.
st.h:
-Sustain party through Ixali Aero III and Garuda AoEs.
-Be ready for burst healing after stack markers if combined with other AoEs.
st.t:
-Hold boss central for consistent path AoEs.
-Assist with positioning group for Hawk markers.

-Distress Beacon = many small adds.

-Turn away for Flash Powder.
-Sanguine Blade = boss leaps + large cleave; move behind.
-S L O P P Y
-Lionshead = swords spawn; kill the **center sword** first, then stand in its cleared space.
-Big Foot = knockback on marked player.

- Floral Haze forces movement by your face-direction debuff; position so the forced march dodges the second Giving Land.
- For Matron's Breath, stand in the color circle matching each numbered beacon as it resolves.
st.d:
- For Sowing Circle, wait for the first two explosions, then move into the resolved lane.
- Spread or stack as marked for Holy-style markers and Furrow.

- Matron's Harvest, Abundance, and Landwaker are raid-wide damage.
- Watch forced-march failures during Floral Haze.
st.t: - Heavens' Earth targets all 3 tanks with AoE tankbusters.

- On platform 2, dodge Ktenos AoEs, then handle the Behemoth proximity marker and front cone.

- Ktenos use Roaring Rumble raid-wide damage.
- Heal the Behemoth proximity hit.
st.t: - Pick up packs and mitigate Sweeping Gouge or Localized Maelstrom tank hits.

- Keep the bosses separated; if too close, they tether and gain Sibling Revelry.
- Resolve Spinner's Wheel debuffs: look/away, stop for Pyretic, or keep moving for Freezing Up.
- Time and Tide can speed up debuff or puddle timing, so resolve earlier than expected.

- For Hydrorythmos, dodge into the previously unsafe line after it resolves.

- Axioma and Inexorable Pull are raid-wide damage.
- Heal Hydrostasis knockbacks and spread damage.
st.t:
- Keep bosses apart.
- Petrai is a shared tankbuster.

st.g:
-Wheel = tankbuster.
-Fire II = spread from others.
-Fire III = raidwide.
-Wild Speed: avoid line dashes; two Optios spawn → kill them, seize cannons, fire at Roader **only when it stops**.
-Roader is invulnerable while speeding.

-Elemental Overload = fire/ice/thunder pattern that dictates the next mechanics.
    -Fire: cones + stack, then Serial Magicks (more cones + stack).
    -Ice: crisscross lines + player AoE circles, then Serial Magicks (lines → circles).
    -Thunder: towers (one player soaks each) + line AoEs, then Serial Magicks (two sets of towers + lines).
-After each elemental sequence the boss is staggered and gains Vulnerability Up → burst.

-Ketu Slash = tankbuster.
-Rahu Blaster = line AoE; sidestep.
-Ketu & Rahu: avoid targeted ground circles.
-Empowered Ketu = tank Bleed→Vuln
-Empowered Rahu = multi-column AoEs + proximity + player AoEs.
-Legion adds: Death Claws tether to players (stun if they reach). Packer walks to device → kill before it reaches.
-If packer is not stopped, Rahu also knockbacks
st.d:
-Kill Death Claws first to prevent grabs.
-Burn Packer immediately to block Quick Charge.

st.g: -Cast Target Search (follows a player, leaves DoT puddle); Tail Laser cleaves front and back.

st.t: -Face boss away and reposition after puddle land to protect party.

st.g: -Uses Mana Burst (raidwide), Orders to Charge (spawns Magitek Bits), Orders to Fire (donut AoEs), Demimagicks (marked donut drops) and Mindjack (out-of-body, stun & body retrieval).
st.d: -Dodge donut circles and puddles. Return to your body quickly when Mindjack occurs.
st.h: -Shield before aoes and restore party quickly after Mindjack transitions.
st.t: -Face boss away and reposition to avoid Demimagick overlaps.

374.g:

-Zenos tethers a player before Lightless Spark (cone AoE); avoid standing near tethered player.
-Phase 2: At ~15%, Zenos summons The Storm, The Swell, and Ame-no-Habakiri. Defeat all before Aether Transfer gauge fills to avoid wipe.
